title: IT Business Partner, Norlandia Health & Care Group, Espoo
description:
WE ARE LOOKING FOR AN IT BUSINESS PARTNER - FINLAND TO JOIN NORLANDIA HEALTH & CARE GROUP AT OUR ESPOO OFFICE

Norlandia Health & Care Group, NHC, provides high-quality early childhood education, elderly care, disability services, child welfare services, patient hotel services, and home care services across Finland. Our operations are built on high quality, responsibility, and a people-centered approach. We are now looking for an experienced IT professional to join our Finnish support organization to strengthen IT services for our businesses and support the continuous development of our operations.

ABOUT THE ROLE
As an IT Business Partner - Finland, you will be responsible for the overall IT function of Norlandia Finland and serve as a trusted IT partner to the business. The role acts as the primary IT partner for the Finnish business while working as an integrated member of the NHC IT organization. The role reports to the Finland Country Manager and NHC IT.

You will work closely with business functions, managers, service providers, and NHC IT team. You approach IT challenges in a practical, proactive, and service-oriented manner, finding effective solutions that support daily operations. Success in this role requires the ability to understand the bigger picture while also being willing to take hands-on responsibility when operational situations require it.

The role includes travel to our locations across Finland sometimes even on a short notice.

NHC has an external IT operation partner, Sopra Steria, who delivers first line support and operates the M365 tenant for all countries in NHC Group. In addition, NHC Group has a centralized internal IT department, NHC IT, which is located in Oslo and Stockholm. NHC IT delivers second and third line support, including network Services to all countries in NHC Group.

EXPECTED SKILLS
Experience in managing outsourced IT services and suppliers
Service Level Agreement (SLA) follow-up
IT Service Management
Vendor Management
Experience in coordinating site openings, acquisitions and IT integrations
Network competence (patching, IPv4, Meraki, Unifi, etc.)
M365, AD DS, Windows 11, Intune environment
Project management in IT projects (startups, system implementation, etc.)
Basic knowledge of office hardware
Ability to develop AI use in the organization is regarded as a benefit

IT uses ServiceNow as a ticketing system and CMDB, and it is an advantage if you are used to ServiceNow or other ticketing systems.

WHAT WE EXPECT FROM YOU
Relevant education and several years of experience in managing, maintaining, and developing IT systems

Ability to work independently, systematically, and in a solution-oriented manner, strong ability to actively seek for solutions for future challenges as well
Excellent collaboration, communication, and customer service skills

Experience working in a multi-site organization or service business environment is considered an advantage

WHAT WE OFFER

An independent role where you can make full use of your expertise
Support from a professional and caring work community
Flexible working arrangements and the possibility of partial remote work
Comprehensive Norlandia employee benefits

title: Forklift Driver (trukkikuski) to Föglö, Åland Islands for the Fish Industry, 7mo fixed term ,
description:
--- *Suomeksi alla* ---

We are now looking for a forklift driver for a fixed term position with good possibility to continue further in the island of Föglö, Åland.

The job involves operating a forklift in various stages of production and storage, such as moving products, loading and unloading cargo, and ensuring the smooth flow of materials in the production area. The forklift in use is a counterbalanced electric forklift (brand: Linde). The work requires good precision, initiative, and the ability to operate safely in a busy environment. The working conditions are cool, around +2 – +6°C, so readiness to work in cold conditions is important. You will also drive the forklift on a slightly sloped yard. If necessary, you can also participate in other production-supporting tasks. At Kalaneuvos, you will become part of a skilled and truly collaborative "work family".

Who is this job suitable for?
We are looking for a communicative person who is capable of working independently and is not afraid to take initiative. Previous experience in operating a forklift is a requirement for this job. You will receive comprehensive training on the specific forklift model and the work environment. The job is suitable for someone who enjoys being close to nature, as the workplace is located on Föglö Island, in a scenic archipelago. You should be able to communicate in English to ensure smooth communication within the team.

- Working hours: 20-37,5h/weekk
- Salary: approx. 12,50-14,00 EUR/h in the beginning, depending on experience
- Collective agreement: Food Industry collective agreement
- Employment: through Bolt
- Start date: flexible according to agreement
- The role has possibility to advance into bigger role

Information about the workplace and practical arrangements:
Föglö does not have city services: the island has K-extra, a library, and a gym, while other city services can be found in Mariehamn, 35 minutes by ferry + 30 minutes by car. You can also manage without a car on the island, as the workplace is close to accommodation and there is a bus to Mariehamn. If desired, we can arrange accommodation for you: you will typically stay with another employee in a two- or three-room apartment, and the rent is around 300-450 EUR, which may or may not include electricity/water, depending on the apartment (you will receive exact information with the job offer).

About Kalaneuvos:
Kalaneuvos is the largest player in the Finnish fish industry and a pioneer in fish processing, fish wholesale, fish import and export, and fish farming. Kalaneuvos has been producing high-quality fish products for over 40 years, focusing not only on product quality but also on modern production methods and employee well-being. The Kalaneuvos brand offers a wide range of delicious fish products. For more information: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Please apply for the job soon: the position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate is found.

--- SUOMEKSI ---

Haemme nyt trukkikuskia määräaikaiseen työsuhteeseen luonnonhelmaan Ahvenanmaan Föglön saareen.

Työtehtäviin kuuluu trukin käyttö tuotannon ja varaston eri työvaiheissa, kuten tuotteiden siirtäminen, kuormien lastaus ja purku, sekä materiaalivirran sujuvuuden varmistaminen tuotantoalueella. Käytössä oleva trukki on vastapainoinen sähkötrukki (merkki: Linde). Työ vaatii hyvää tarkkuutta, oma-aloitteisuutta sekä kykyä toimia turvallisesti kiireisessä ympäristössä. Työskentelytilat ovat viileät, noin +2 – +6°C, joten valmius työskennellä kylmässä on tärkeää. Ajat trukkia myös hieman kaltevalla pihalla. Tarpeen mukaan voit osallistua myös muihin tuotantoa tukeviin työtehtäviin. Kalaneuvoksella pääset osaksi ammattitaitoista ja todellakin yhteen hiileen puhaltavaa "työperhettä".

Kenelle työ sopii?
Etsimme kommunikaatiotaitoista ja itsenäiseen työskentelyyn kykenevää henkilöä, joka ei pelkää tarttua toimeen. Aiempi kokemus trukin käytöstä on vaatimuksena tälle työlle. Saat toki kattavan perehdytyksen kyseiseen trukkimalliin sekä työympäristöön. Työ sopii luonnon läheiselle henkilölle, sillä työpaikka sijaitsee Föglön saarella, saaristomaisemissa. Puhuthan englantia, jotta kommunikaatio työporukassa sujuu ongelmitta.

- Työtunnit: 20-37,5h/vko
- Palkkaus: n. 12,50-14,00eur/h, kokemuksen mukaan
- Työehtosopimus: Elintarvikealan TES
- Työsuhde: Boltin kautta
- Aloitus joustavasti sopimuksen mukaan
- Roolissa on hyvä mahdollisuus edetä

Tietoa työskentelypaikkakunnasta ja käytännön järjestelyissä:
Föglössä ei ole kaupungin palveluita: saarella on K-extra, kirjasto ja kuntosali, ja muutoin kaupungin palvelut löytyvät esim. Maarianhaminasta, 35min lauttamatkan ja 30min ajomatkan päästä. Saarella pärjää myös ilman autoa, sillä työpaikka on lähellä majoitusta ja Maarianhaminaan pääsee bussilla. Halutessasi järjestämme sinulle majoituksen: majoitut tyypillisesti toisen työntekijän kanssa rivitalokaksiossa tai -kolmiossa, ja vuokra on n. 300-450eur, ja sisältää, tai ei sisällä sähköä / vettä, riippuen asunnosta (saat tarkan tiedon työtarjouksen yhteydessä).

Tietoa Kalaneuvoksesta:
Kalaneuvos on Suomen kalateollisuuden suurin toimija ja alan edelläkävijä kalanjalostuksessa, kalatukkukaupassa, kalan tuonnissa ja viennissä sekä kalankasvatuksessa. Kalaneuvos on valmistanut korkealaatuisia kalatuotteita jo yli 40 vuoden ajan panostaen tuotteiden laadun lisäksi nykyaikaisiin tuotantomenetelmiin sekä henkilöstön hyvinvointiin. Kalaneuvos-brändin alta löytyy laaja valikoima herkullisia kalatuotteita. Lisätietoja: www.kalaneuvos.fi

Haethan työpaikkaa pian: paikka täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Early Childhood Education Teacher (recruitment from abroad, permanent position in public sector daycare))
description:
Hello, Early Childhood Education Teachers! Are you interested in working in a public daycare in Finland, known for its high-quality education system? We offer a permanent full-time position, competitive salary, great employee benefits, free Finnish language training, apartment, relocation support, and a clear pathway to living and working in Finland. Whether you are an experienced Early Childhood Education Teacher or newly qualified, we at the City of Helsinki would be delighted to hear from you!

In Finland, ECE teachers are highly trusted professionals. You have significant autonomy in planning pedagogical activities and are encouraged to use your professional expertise in everyday work. You support the holistic development of children aged 0-6 in an inclusive, child-centred environment. You work in a multi-professional team, sharing responsibility for childrens wellbeing and learning.

In Finland, ECE is part of the national education system and follows the Educare model, integrating care, education and teaching (read more from the Finnish National Agency for Education: https://www.oph.fi/en/education-system/early-childhood-education-and-care-finland). In practice, this means that:
Every moment is pedagogical
Play is the foundation of learning
Learning happens throughout the whole day
Nature and outdoor environments are used yearround
Childrens interests and questions guide learning

Your core responsibilities:
Plan, implement and assess play-based learning activities
Lead your groups pedagogical work together with childcare nurses
Observe and document childrens learning and development
Create and update individual learning plans in collaboration with families
Collaborate with colleagues and multidisciplinary professionals
Design inspiring learning environments indoors and outdoors

Our daycare units' opening hours range between 6:15-17:30, depending on families needs. As a full-time teacher you work 38.25 hours per week Monday-Friday.

We are looking for professionals who connect well with others and are open to learning and professional growth. You value teamwork and recognise that high-quality pedagogy is built together. You will enjoy this role if you want to fully use your pedagogical expertise and appreciate professional trust and autonomy. You are an advocate of play-based learning and see learning opportunities in everyday moments. As a professional you are reflective, curious and resilient.

Qualification and other requirements to start the Finnish language course in February 2027:
Right to work in Finland, for example, on the basis of EU/EEA citizenship
At least Bachelors degree in Early Childhood Education Your qualification gives you the right to work as an Early Childhood Education Teacher for children aged 0-6 years in the country where the degree was obtained.
At least level B2 in English language
Willingness and ability to commit to learning Finnish language prior to employment contract and relocation. The working language in our daycares is Finnish. During the language course we test your language skill development regularly.

Requirements to enter into a permanent employment contract in January 2028:
Reaching target level B1 in Finnish language
Decision from the Finnish National Agency of Education demonstrating eligibility to work as an ECE teacher in Finland
Criminal record extract from the Legal Register Centre
Proof that you do not have respiratory tuberculosis

We can only enter into a permanent employment contract with you if you meet all the above requirements.

We provide comprehensive support to make your relocation to Finland as smooth as possible:
Assistance with degree recognition process
Remote Finnish language training (10 months, part-time, 4x90min lessons every week + 4-8h/wk independent study, homework and assignments) which you can complete alongside your current employment
Pre-departure training also includes practical information about working and living in Finland
Support in registrations with Finnish authorities upon arrival (also for relocating family members)
Assistance in finding an apartment. As a City of Helsinki employee, you can rent a City-owned apartment and no rental deposit is required.

Language training and relocation schedule:
Feb'27-Dec'27: Finnish language training remotely. Attendance and active participation is essential.
Jan'28: Relocation to Finland and starting work.

Salary and benefits:
Starting salary: €3,298/mth +3-8% experience-based supplements for 5-10 yrs of relevant experience
ePassi benefit: €550/year (sports, culture, wellbeing, commuting)
Comprehensive private occupational health care
Paid annual leave: 23-28 days + 5 extra days for qualified teachers
Holiday bonus pay

Watch our teachers who have already relocated share their experiences of pedagogical work, life in Finland, and the support they received in the relocation process:
Álvaro and Eva: https://youtu.be/KhcaHeu-xLc
Melissa: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6eyjJjnxRiY
Yaiza: https://youtu.be/4IPA8d0pkI4

We warmly welcome you to join a workplace that values your expertise and recognises the potential in both you and the children!

Please note:
(ENG) If you are already living in Finland and hold a degree in early childhood education obtained abroad, please do not apply through this path. Instead, explore our other employment opportunities at www.helsinkirekry.fi and https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals or contact us at rekry.kasko@hel.fi.
(FIN) Jos asut jo Suomessa ja sinulla on ulkomailla suoritettu varhaiskasvatuksen tutkinto, älä hae tähän polkuun. Tutustu sen sijaan muihin työpaikkoihimme osoitteessa www.helsinkirekry.fi ja työllistymispolkuihimme osoitteessa https://www.hel.fi/en/open-jobs/for-education-professionals, tai ota meihin yhteyttä: rekry.kasko@hel.fi.

title: Laboratory Test Engineer
description:
For our client we are looking for a Laboratory Test Engineer to strengthen the project engineering team on automation and protection testing including real time simulations. 

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in power systems, testing and real time simulations. The role focuses on designing and implementing automation, protection and secondary injection tests according to customer specifications. Ideally, the candidate has a vision on how to productize simulation and testing offering. 

You will be mainly accountable for:
· Designing and implementing automation and protection testing including hardware-in-the-loop testing for power systems according to customer specifications
· Leading customer approvals and factory testing of distribution protection relays
· Maintaining the customer approval test laboratory in Vaasa
· Productizing the simulation and test offering

Qualifications For The Role:
· A B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in electrical or electrical power system engineering or equivalent
· Several years of experience working with power systems and prior experience with electrical installations or a commissioning background
· Prior experience of leading customer approvals or FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing)
· Experience with real time simulators such as RTDS, Typhoon Hil or Opal RT and relay test devices and amplifiers such as Omicron
· Experience with PSCAD or a similar software is seen as a strong benefit
· Good communication and presentation skills, including fluency in English (written and spoken), Finnish and Swedish language skills are seen as benefits

Answer these questions separately in a few sentences and attach them to your application! (Mandatory!)
- Do you have a B.Sc. or M.Sc. degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field?*
- Do you have at least 3 years of experience working with power systems, electrical installations, or commissioning activities?*
- Have you previously led or participated in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) or customer approval testing for protection or automation systems?*
- Do you have hands-on experience with real-time simulation tools such as RTDS, Typhoon HIL, or OPAL-RT?*
- Do you have experience using relay testing equipment such as Omicron test sets or similar protection testing devices?*
- Do you have experience with PSCAD or similar power system simulation software?*

title: Logistic & Event Specialist
description:
**Logistics Specialist — Events, Cleaning & Facility Operations**

**Hype Siivous | Helsinki, Finland Full-time or part-time**

Hype Siivous is looking for a reliable, practical and proactive Logistics Specialist to support event preparation, cleaning and daily operations at an innovation facility hosting approximately 500–600 internal community and private events annually.

This hands-on role combines furniture setup, equipment movement, cleaning and facility support. You will take ownership of assigned tasks, communicate clearly and help leave every space safe, organised and ready for use.

Cleaning is a regular and essential part of this position. The role is not limited to event logistics or furniture preparation.

**_YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES_**

Event preparation and logistics Prepare meeting rooms and event spaces according to agreed floor plans and event requirements. Arrange tables, chairs and equipment with attention to presentation, accessibility and safe movement. Handle load-in and load-out: move furniture, equipment and supplies into and out of the venue. Move items between nearby spaces or locations, including driving when assigned. Support orderly venue entry and departure, keeping entrances, exits and circulation routes clear. Restore furniture and equipment after events. Check equipment and furniture and report damage or missing items. Follow safe lifting and handling procedures, using suitable equipment and team support.

Cleaning and facility care Clean and prepare spaces before, during and after events. Vacuum and mop floors, wipe tables, chairs and accessible surfaces, empty bins and remove ordinary waste. Carry out assigned cleaning of meeting rooms, event spaces, common areas, kitchens or kitchenettes, and washrooms. Leave spaces clean, organised and ready for their next use. Use cleaning products and equipment safely, following training and site instructions. Report maintenance needs, missing supplies and cleanliness or safety concerns.

Communication and ownership Coordinate with the Event Manager and facility team on schedules, layouts, changes and readiness. Plan and prioritise work during busy periods. Complete tasks with limited supervision while keeping colleagues informed. Provide clear handovers and report delays or unfinished tasks promptly. Follow through on commitments, take responsibility and ask for support when needed. Help coordinate practical setup tasks with colleagues when assigned.

The balance between logistics, event preparation and cleaning varies with the event schedule and facility needs. Duties are carried out within the agreed role, training and safe working practices.

**_What we are looking for_**

Relevant experience in event logistics, furniture setup, cleaning, facility operations or similar practical work. A valid category B driving licence and driving experience. Excellent practical English for understanding instructions, coordinating tasks and reporting issues. Finnish and/or Swedish language skills are an advantage, but are not required. Ability to safely perform physically demanding logistics and cleaning duties, using appropriate handling equipment and team support. Good understanding of room layouts and furniture positioning. Strong organisation, attention to detail and a cooperative attitude towards logistics and cleaning duties. Initiative, practical leadership and a strong sense of responsibility. A calm, solution-focused approach when schedules change or deadlines are tight. Ability to work independently while staying connected with the team.

Work eligibility: Applicants must have a valid right to work in Finland for this role and a lawful basis to reside in Finland. Where a residence permit is required, it must be valid and allow the work concerned. Relevant documentation will be verified before employment begins.

Preferred qualifications: An Occupational Safety Card (Työturvallisuuskortti) and Hygiene Passport (Hygieniapassi) are advantages, but are not mandatory requirements for applying.

**_Employment and working hours_**

Full-time: Permanent employment, 37.5 hours per week. Full-time work and onboarding start on 15 January 2027.

Part-time: Starts immediately and continues until further notice. Variable working hours of 0–20 hours per week. No minimum weekly hours are guaranteed.

Schedule: Monday to Saturday, with agreed early-morning, daytime or evening shifts according to event bookings. Workload varies seasonally, with greater staffing needs during busy periods. Flexibility means working agreed shifts—not being available around the clock. 6.5 hours a day.

Pay: According to the applicable collective agreement.

**_What we offer_**

A varied role combining event logistics, cleaning and facility support. An active innovation environment with community and private events. Opportunities to take ownership of practical operations and develop coordination skills. Collaboration with event management and the facility team. Onboarding into venue layouts, equipment, cleaning methods and safety procedures.

**_How to apply_**

Send your CV and a short introduction to **_employment@hypesiivous.fi_** by 31 October 2026.

Please include: Your relevant logistics, event preparation and cleaning experience. Your driving experience and licence category. Your language skills, including English and any Finnish or Swedish. Your availability and earliest starting date. Whether you are applying for part-time or full-time work. Whether you hold an Occupational Safety Card or Hygiene Passport. Confirmation of whether you currently have the right to work in Finland for this role.

Please do not send passport or residence-permit copies with your initial application. Relevant documentation will be checked securely before employment begins.

We assess applicants on their skills, experience and ability to perform the role safely.

title: Project Assistant, Metso
description:
Metso is a frontrunner in sustainable technologies, end-to-end solutions and services for the aggregates, minerals processing and metals refining industries globally. We improve our customers energy and water efficiency, increase their productivity, and reduce environmental risks with our product and service expertise. We are the partner for positive change.

Metso is headquartered in Espoo, Finland. At the end of 2025 Metso had close to 18,000 employees in around 50 countries, and sales in 2025 were about EUR 5.3 billion. Metso is listed on the Nasdaq Helsinki.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/c6d6529a-671b-48f7-b799-567e88253d31/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Project Assistant?

We are looking for a Project Assistant to join Metsos Document Control and Project Support team. You will be part of large international plant delivery projects, supporting delivery teams and ensuring that practical arrangements run smoothly and efficiently.

In this role, you organize travel arrangements for project personnel and customers, including flights, accommodation, and ground transportation. You prepare visa invitation letters for customers and suppliers and coordinate visa and work permit processes for project personnel across different countries.

You organize meetings both at the office and at external locations, ensuring that all arrangements are in place. You take care of ordering necessary materials such as personal protective equipment (PPE) and business gifts, and act as a key contact for travel agencies. In addition, you handle travel-related invoices and maintain up-to-date traveler profiles.

This is a full-time, one-year fixed-term position with the strong possibility of continuation. The position starts as soon as possible. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Metso. The position is based in Espoo and requires working at the office 3 days per week.

What are we looking for?

To succeed in this role, you bring a few years of experience from assistant or project support roles. You are comfortable working with MS Office tools and have experience with invoice handling and travel expense systems. You are familiar with visa and work permit processes in different countries, and you have a good understanding of travel safety and handling travel-related personal data. Fluent Finnish and English skills, both written and spoken, are essential, and additional language skills are considered an asset.

You have a structured and detail-oriented approach to your work and can prioritize effectively and adapt to changing situations. You take ownership of your responsibilities while collaborating smoothly as part of a team. Experience working in an international environment and an understanding of different cultures are considered an advantage.

Why us?

We value our dedicated and driven professionals. As an important part of our highly motivated and skilled team, you contribute directly to our shared success. We offer you an exciting opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders, supported by an open-minded, international, and friendly community of experts. Once you have a solid grasp of the job, you will have the flexibility to work partly remotely, along with excellent opportunities to develop your professional skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge company at the forefront of its industry. We're committed to your success and will provide you with a comprehensive onboarding and a supportive environment where you can truly thrive. We offer occupational healthcare and a lunch benefit as employee benefits.

Are you interested?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application either in English or Finnish via the link by 23.10.2026. The interviewing process will begin during the application period, and the position will be filled as soon as the right candidate is found. Unfortunately, we are unable to provide relocation assistance to Finland.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator, email: elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi [elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi].

title: Embedded electronics and integration engineer
description:
**Role summary**

You are a hands-on electronics engineer focused on fast build–assemble–test–integrate cycles for reference models and NRE projects. Your work shortens iteration loops and increases throughput across multiple customer deliveries, ensuring hardware modules are built and validated reliably.

**What youll do**

- Assemble and bring up PCBs and modules; validate electrical and optical subsystems against defined checks and acceptance criteria.Debug hardware issues efficiently (power, signals, timing, communication, sensor behavior) and document findings and fixes.

- Support integration with firmware/software teams, including effective data sharing on interfaces such as UART/SPI/I²C, timing coordination, power modes, and logging/telemetry.

- Maintain practical test setups and measurement pipelines: fixtures, rigs, scripts, checklists, build documentation, and bench discipline to ensure repeatable results and smooth transfer to manufacturing.

- Interact with manufacturing and component partners to support builds, resolve issues, and improve build quality and consistency.

- Contribute to next-generation hardware concepts through component evaluations, sensor/illumination experiments, and new integration approaches — improving delivery speed and reducing rework across NRE and customer builds.


**What we expect**

- Strong hands-on competence in embedded electronics: PCB/module assembly, bring-up, debugging, and systematic fault isolation.

- Comfort with lab instrumentation and measurement workflows (e.g., oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters; building reliable test routines).

- Practical understanding of embedded interfaces and system integration constraints (UART/SPI/I²C, timing, power, signal integrity at a working level).

- Documentation discipline: you leave behind clear build notes, checklists, and test procedures others can repeat.

- Ability to work independently in a small team, prioritize effectively, and unblock others quickly.

- Experience with optical/IR components, cameras, illumination, or sensor systems is a plus.

- Embedded programming experience (including FPGA-adjacent and HDL work) is a plus, but not required.


**What we offer**

- A core role in building and validating real hardware in a deep-tech company shipping demanding sensing systems.

- Direct impact on delivery speed, reliability, and customer success; close collaboration with the founders and the core engineering team.

- Variety of work across reference designs, customer NRE builds, and next-generation prototypes.

- Competitive compensation aligned with experience; potential equity participation depending on role seniority and responsibilities.

- A culture that values technical rigor, clear communication, and practical execution over bureaucracy.

- Comprehensive health-care package, gym access


**Details**

Reporting to: Chief Technology Officer

Location: Joensuu, Finland, on-site work

Travel: Infrequent

Work authorization: Relocation assistance provided

**Send or submit your CV and portfolio.**

title: Corporate Trainer, EMEA
description:

title: Operations Manager for Lapland Luxury DMC
description:
Lapland Luxury DMC is a private destination management company (DMC) specialising in tailor-made luxury experiences in Lapland. Our portfolio includes Hidden Arctic Cloud Villas, located approximately 30 minutes from Rovaniemi city centre, AINO Private Island, and other exclusive luxury villas.

We are now looking for a passionate and experienced Operations Manager to lead and develop our operations in Lapland Luxury DMC and ensure exceptional experiences for our international guests.

**About the role:**

As an Operations Manager, you will play a key role in ensuring the smooth daily operations and high-quality delivery of Lapland Luxury's exclusive experiences and services.

You will lead your team, coordinate operational resources, and work closely with other departments to ensure that every guest experience meets our high standards. In this role, you will combine hands-on operational leadership with a proactive approach to developing our services, processes, and ways of working.

**Your key responsibilities include:**

- Operational management – overseeing the daily operations, quality, and delivery of Lapland Luxury's services and guest experiences.

- Team leadership and development – recruiting, onboarding, training, and supervising team members while fostering a positive and service-oriented working environment.

- Resource planning and coordination – ensuring effective scheduling and coordination of operational resources to support seamless service delivery.

- Guest experience and customer relationships – maintaining exceptional service standards, managing guest-related matters, and continuously improving customer satisfaction.

- Service and event coordination – planning and coordinating tailored experiences, activities, and events in close collaboration with other departments and partners.

- Continuous improvement – actively developing operational processes, service quality, and efficiency to ensure the fulfilment of our customer promise.


**What we expect from you:**

We are looking for a confident, hands-on leader who thrives in a dynamic hospitality environment and is passionate about delivering outstanding guest experiences.

To succeed in this role, we value:

- Previous experience in operational management, hospitality or tourism

- Strong leadership and people management skills, with the ability to motivate, support, and develop a team.

- Excellent organizational, planning, and problem-solving skills.

- A genuine passion for exceptional customer service and attention to detail.

- A proactive and solution-oriented mindset, with the ability to take ownership and make decisions independently.

- Flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced environment where priorities may change.

- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across teams and build lasting customer relationships.

- Fluency in English; other languages are considered an advantage.

- Good digital skills and the ability to manage operational systems and processes.


We expect you to have previous experience in luxury hospitality, destination management, or Arctic programme services, along with a solid understanding of delivering high-quality guest experiences.

**What we offer:**

At Lapland Luxury, you will have the opportunity to lead and develop exceptional hospitality experiences in one of the most unique destinations in the world.

We offer you:

- A diverse and responsible management role within an exclusive luxury hospitality environment.

- The opportunity to make a real impact on operational excellence, guest experiences, and service development.

- A supportive and collaborative team within the SantaPark Arctic World.

- The opportunity to work with international guests and unique, tailor-made luxury experiences.

- Professional development opportunities and the chance to grow your leadership expertise.

- An inspiring working environment surrounded by the extraordinary nature of Finnish Lapland.

- Full-time, permanent contract

- Employee benefits across the SantaPark Arctic World group.


Position will be filled as soon as the right person is found so please send your application soon - We are excited to hear from you!

title: IT-Manager
description:
SantaPark Arctic World on matkailu ja elämysalan yritys, jonka toiminnan ytimessä ovat ainutlaatuiset elämykset, lämminhenkinen palvelu ja intohimo erinomaisuuteen. Konserniimme kuuluvat SantaPark – Christmas Theme Park, Santa Claus Secret Forest – Joulukka, Arctic TreeHouse Hotel, Rakas Restaurant & Bar, Hidden Arctic Cloud Villas, AINO Private Island sekä Lapland Luxury DMC.

Tavoitteenamme on luoda vieraillemme elinikäisiä muistoja. Haluamme tarjota myös henkilöstöllemme innostavan työympäristön, jossa on mahdollisuus oppia, kehittyä ja rakentaa yhdessä jotakin ainutlaatuista.

Etsimme kokenutta ja kehittämishenkistä IT Manageria vastaamaan konsernimme IT-ympäristön toimivuudesta, turvallisuudesta ja jatkuvasta kehittämisestä. Tehtävässä yhdistyvät IT-kokonaisuuksien hallinta, kehitysprojektit ja käytännönläheinen ongelmanratkaisu. Työskentelet tiiviissä yhteistyössä konsernin CTO, ulkoisen IT-palvelukumppanin ja liiketoimintayksiköidemme kanssa varmistaen, että teknologiset ratkaisumme tukevat sujuvaa arkea ja korkeatasoista asiakaskokemusta.

**Keskeiset vastuualueesi:**

- Konsernin IT-ympäristön, järjestelmien, laitteiden ja infrastruktuurin hallinta ja kehittäminen

- IT-strategian toteuttaminen, IT-budjetin seuranta ja kehityshankkeiden koordinointi

- Tietoturvan, tietosuojan ja järjestelmien toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen

- IT-palvelukumppaneiden, toimittajasuhteiden ja palvelutasojen hallinta

- Järjestelmäkäyttöönottojen, integraatioiden ja muiden IT-projektien johtaminen

- Henkilöstön IT-tuen sujuvuuden varmistaminen sekä vaativampien teknisten haasteiden ratkaiseminen


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Etsimme oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä IT-alan ammattilaista, joka hallitsee laajoja kokonaisuuksia ja tarttuu tarvittaessa myös käytännön tekemiseen.

Odotamme sinulta:

- Soveltuvaa IT-alan koulutusta tai vastaavaa työkokemuksen kautta hankittua osaamista

- Vahvaa kokemusta IT-ympäristöjen hallinnasta ja kehittämisestä sekä vastuullisista IT-tehtävistä

- Hyvää osaamista verkoista, pilvipalveluista, tietoturvasta ja liiketoimintajärjestelmistä

- Kokemusta IT-projektien johtamisesta, toimittajayhteistyöstä ja kustannusten hallinnasta

- Itsenäistä ja kehittämisorientoitunutta työotetta sekä hyviä yhteistyö- ja ongelmanratkaisutaitoja

- Sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa


Arvostamme kokemusta matkailu-, majoitus- tai palvelualalta sekä ymmärrystä sesonkiluonteisen liiketoiminnan erityispiirteistä.

**Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?**

- Monipuolisen ja vastuullisen tehtävän ainutlaatuisessa matkailualan konsernissa

- Mahdollisuuden vaikuttaa konsernin IT-ratkaisuihin ja kehittää toimintaa pitkäjänteisesti

- Itsenäisen roolin ja tiivistä yhteistyötä eri liiketoimintojen, johdon ja IT-asiantuntijoiden kanssa

- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa osaamistasi ja kasvaa ammatillisesti

- Innostavan ja yhteistyöhenkisen työyhteisön sekä SantaPark Arctic Worldin henkilöstöedut


Tehtävä on kokoaikainen ja vakituinen, ja työskentelypaikkasi sijaitsee Rovaniemellä. Työhön sisältyy liikkumista konsernin eri toimipisteiden välillä. Raportoit tehtävässä talousjohtajallemme.

Lähetä hakemuksesi ansioluetteloineen viimeistään 26.10.2026 - Odotamme innolla kuulevamme sinusta!

title: Aana Palvelut Oy, Henkilökohtainen avustaja Huittisiin
description:
Etsitkö ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa saat samalla vaikuttaa omiin työaikoihisi?
Haluatko työn, joka mukautuu elämäntilanteeseesi eikä vaadi aiempaa koulutusta tai pitkää työkokemusta?
Olemme käynnistämässä henkilökohtaisen avun palvelutoimintaa, jossa työ rakentuu sinun ja asiakkaan arjen ympärille.

Aana Palvelut työnantajana

Aana Palvelut on uusi henkilökohtaiseen apuun keskittyvä yritys.
Rakennamme toimintaamme yhdessä avustajien ja asiakkaiden kanssa – avoimesti, inhimillisesti ja luottamukseen perustuen.
Emme etsi työntekijöitä järjestelmään, vaan ihmisiä ihmisille. Sinusta tulee tärkeä osa jonkun arkea.

Mitä henkilökohtainen avustaminen on?

Henkilökohtaisena avustajana autat asiakasta elämään omannäköistään elämää sairauden tai vamman tuomista rajoitteista huolimatta. Työsi on käytännönläheistä, vaihtelevaa ja merkityksellistä.
Avustaminen voi sisältää esimerkiksi:
- kodin arjen askareissa avustamista,
- asiointia ja liikkumista kodin ulkopuolella,
- harrastuksiin ja vapaa-ajan toimintoihin osallistumista.

Kenelle työ sopii?

Etsimme ihmisiä, joilla on aito halu auttaa ja kohdata toinen ihminen arvostavasti ja luontevasti. Et tarvitse aiempaa koulutusta tai kokemusta.
Arvostamme luotettavuutta, avoimuutta ja halua oppia. Perehdytämme sinut työhön ja olemme tukenasi myös arjessa. Meille on tärkeää, että voit olla oma itsesi.

Joustavat työajat

Keskustelemme kanssasi siitä, millainen työmäärä ja aikataulu sopivat elämäntilanteeseesi. Työ voi olla kokoaikaista, osa-aikaista tai keikkaluonteista. Noudatamme palvelualan työehtosopimusta.

Henkilökohtaiseksi avustajaksi otettavan henkilön on esitettävä alle 6 kuukautta vanha rikosrekisteriote työnantajalle ennen työn aloittamista. Rikosrekisteriote haetaan sähköisesti Oikeusrekisterikeskuksesta työnhakijan toimesta.

title: Site Engineers (Multiple Disciplines), Granlund
description:
Are you ready to take an active role in site supervision across demanding international projects? We are now looking for Site Engineers across several technical disciplines to join Granlunds growing Site Services team.

Granlund is a rapidly growing expert organization in the real estate and construction sector. Together with our clients and stakeholders, we are building a sustainable and intelligent future. Our more than 1,600 professionals serve across 30 locations throughout Finland.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/547f419b-5389-4d1d-9b3c-4499da3384d1/original.png]

Would you be one of our new Site Engineers?
As a Site Engineer, you will be responsible for site supervision within your own technical discipline, whether your expertise lies in Civil, Structural, Architectural, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical, ICT, Security, Automation, or Moisture Management. As the client's technical representative on site, you will play a key role in ensuring that technically demanding projects are executed according to approved plans, technical requirements, contractual obligations, and agreed quality standards.

In your daily work, you will monitor project progress, review installations, materials, and work phases, and ensure that execution aligns with approved plans and technical requirements. You will interpret technical drawings and project documentation, document your observations in digital systems, and help ensure that any quality issues or deviations are addressed appropriately. As a key link between the site and the wider project organization, you will provide accurate and up-to-date information on project progress and site activities.

The positions are full-time and permanent, and you will be employed directly by Granlund. The work is strongly site-based, with projects located throughout Finland. The most suitable project location will be discussed during the recruitment process. The role requires regular presence at project sites and readiness to travel.

What are we looking for?
We are looking for professionals who enjoy working close to construction and industrial projects and want to take responsibility for quality and technical execution on site. You have experience in site supervision, quality control, or technical project environments, along with a relevant engineering degree and the ability to interpret technical drawings, plans, and project documentation.

Your background may, for example, be in Civil, Structural or Architectural Engineering, Mechanical (HVAC), Electrical Engineering, ICT, Security, Automation or Moisture Management. Regardless of your discipline, you have a few years of experience working on construction or industrial projects and are comfortable operating in a site-based environment.

Experience with Dalux or Autodesk Construction Cloud is considered an advantage. Fluent English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered an advantage. You will also need a valid driving licence and readiness to work regularly at project sites.

You are proactive, quality-conscious, and eager to develop your expertise. You take responsibility for your work, communicate effectively with different stakeholders, and are not afraid to raise concerns when quality, safety, or project requirements are at risk.

Why join us?
At Granlund, you will work in a company that has been a pioneer in Finnish building services engineering for decades. You will contribute to demanding and large-scale projects such as data centers and commercial environments, where your work truly matters. As one of the leading data center design and consulting companies in the Nordics, we offer long-term career opportunities in a rapidly growing field, where projects are becoming increasingly significant in scale and impact. You will have strong opportunities to grow and develop your expertise, with career paths that can be shaped around your strengths and interests.

We place real emphasis on employee well-being, continuous learning, and a supportive, professional work environment. You will be part of a collaborative and ambitious team where people take ownership, share knowledge, and work together toward common goals.

Are you interested?
Could you be our new colleague? Please submit your application via the link either in English or Finnish as soon as possible, but no later than 18.10.2026. We will begin interviews during the application period may close the job posting earlier if the positions are filled.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information, please contact Biisonis Recruitment Consultant Nea Repo (nea.repo@biisoni.fi [nea.repo@biisoni.fi]).

title: Chef, Lapland Hotels SnowVillage, Kittilä
description:
StaffPoint is looking for CHEFS for the winter season 2026–2027 at Lapland Hotels SnowVillage.

Every year in November, a unique frozen experience is built in Lainio, covering an area of about 2 hectares. It features stunning ice sculptures, an ice restaurant and an ice bar. Reception and kitchen facilities, however, are warmly housed within log walls. The SnowVillage attracts around 80,000 visitors annually and its theme changes every year. Located near the Levi and Ylläs ski resorts, the location ensures a vibrant winter season. The distance is approx. 45 km from Levi, 30 km from Äkäslompolo, and 15 km from Ylläsjärvi.

The position includes duties in both à la carte and buffet kitchen operations. Employment is scheduled to begin on 23 November 2026 and continue until approximately 4 April 2027. Full-time work is available, with 112.5 hours per three-week period. The employment contract will be signed between the employee and StaffPoint. Please note that the Lapland Hotels chain is a smoke-free workplace.

What we require:

- EU citizenship/passport or a valid working permit for Finland

- Minimum of two years' experience of working in a kitchen as a chef

- Creativity, initiative, and a positive attitude that is reflected in your way of working

- Finnish Hygiene certificate (We can provide assistance with applying for a certificate)

- Strong understanding of food safety and kitchen procedures

What we offer:

- A lively and international work environment

- Staffpoint and Lapland Hotels personnel benefits

- A great, close-knit team that many employees return to season after season

- The possibility of accommodation through Lapland Hotels

- Salary based on your experience, at least in accordance with the Finnish collective agreement for the hospitality industry (Marava TES)

Accommodation is located approximately 15 km from the workplace, so having your own car or a valid driving licence will be considered an advantage.

How to apply:

Add your CV to your application to speed up the recruitment process! Please note that if you are applying with a friend, both applicants must submit their own application. If you meet our standards, you will first receive an invitation to a video interview and a Refapp request for recommendations.

Submit your job application and we'll see you in magical Lapland!

Please note that we do not accept applications via email due to GDPR regulations. All applications should be submitted through our website.


Lapland Hotels

Lapland Hotels & Safaris Oy offers northern experiences for all senses. It consists of Finland's largest private hotel chain Lapland Hotels, the Nordic region's largest program service company Lapland Safaris, and Lapland Ski Resorts. The entire group employs a total of about 1,950 people.

Lapland Hotels includes 20 hotels, over 2,600 rooms and apartments, and more than 11,000 restaurant seats throughout Finland: in Ylläs, Levi, Saariselkä, Rovaniemi, Olos, Luosto, Kilpisjärvi, Pallas, and Hetta, as well as in Helsinki, Tampere, Oulu, Kuopio, and Kartano & Spa Hotel Haikko in Porvoo.

Lapland Safaris offers unique nature activities in Lapland's five locations: Rovaniemi, Ylläs, Saariselkä, Levi, and Luosto. title: Mechanical Engineer, Konecranes
description:
We are now looking for a Mechanical Engineer to join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and contribute to some of the world's most demanding crane engineering projects.

Konecranes moves what matters. We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with more than 16,000 professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment free from discrimination and where diversity, equity and inclusion are valued.

[https://images.teamtailor-cdn.com/images/s3/teamtailor-production/original-v3/image_uploads/49cf9064-f425-4d1c-b5e9-ecfdc64d4c69/original.jpeg]

Would you be our new Mechanical Engineer?

As a Mechanical Engineer, you will join Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes team and work on some of the world's largest and most technically demanding crane projects.

Your responsibilities include structural analyses, strength calculations and mechanical design throughout both the tendering and project execution phases. You will perform strength analyses, mass, cross-sectional and machinery calculations, transportation and erection analyses, and support design decisions by interpreting standards, specifications and customer requirements.

Working closely with designers, project teams and customers, you will contribute to solving complex engineering challenges while gradually taking on broader technical responsibilities. The role offers a unique opportunity to develop towards future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities with support from experienced senior engineering professionals.

The position is full-time and employed through Biisoni. The role offers flexible working hours, a hybrid working model with approximately one office day per week in Hyvinkää, and international travel of around 30-60 days per year.

What are we looking for?

We are looking for an engineer with experience in strength analysis and steel structures. Your background may come from industrial machinery, mobile equipment, heavy industrial equipment, steel structures, or similar engineering environments.

To succeed in this role, you have a good understanding of structural mechanics, strength calculations, dynamic analysis and mechanical design as well as the ability to interpret 2D engineering drawings. A Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, with major in Machine Design, Steel Structures, Engineering Mechanics or similar is preferred, but candidates with relevant practical experience are also encouraged to apply.

Experience with Finnsap, NX, Simcenter, Ansys, or similar engineering tools is considered an advantage. Strong communication skills in English are required, while Finnish language skills are considered a plus. As a person, you are analytical, proactive and eager to learn. You enjoy solving technical challenges, taking ownership and developing your expertise over the long term.

Why us?

Konecranes' Shipyard Cranes business offers a highly specialised engineering environment where every project is unique. You will work on some of the worlds largest and most technically advanced shipyard cranes, learn from experienced experts and build expertise in demanding structural engineering and strength analysis. The role provides a clear development path towards broader engineering responsibility and future mechanical Chief Project Engineer responsibilities in an international project environment.

Have we got your interest?

If you are interested, we want to hear from you as soon as possible! Please submit your application via the link by 30.10.2026. We review applications and start interviews already during the application period.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. The employment relationship will be established with Biisoni. For more information about the position, please contact Saija Salter, Recruitment Consultant, via email at saija.salter@biisoni.fi [saija.salter@biisoni.fi].

title: Trädgårdsunderhåll Trädgårdmästare Trädgårdsarbetare
description:
Vår franska trädgårdsfirma, Jardin Riviera, utgår utanför Nice på Franska Rivieran och arbetar i ett område på cirka 30 km.

Vi söker mer personal med heltidstjänst på tillsvidareanställning då vi har mer än fullt upp med våra projekt i olika trädgårdar.

Under vinterhalvåret bygger vi mycket trädgårdar och under sommarhalvåret är det underhåll som gäller. Vi utför i stort sett alla arbetsuppgifter som uppkommer i en trädgård.

Ni kan läsa mer om företaget och hur vi jobbar på vår hemsida www.jardinriviera.com

Vi behöver en morgonpigg, positiv och glad person som gillar att ta del av teamets kunskaper och vår service.

Du är proaktiv, ansvarstagande, har god lyssningsförmåga, visar nyfikenhet och är bra på att interagera och planera ditt arbete.

Vi letar efter dig som sätter ett värde i att utföra arbetet på bästa möjliga vis och som inte är rädd för att hugga i när och där det behövs.

För att lyckas och trivas i tjänsten behöver du vara serviceinriktad och ta ansvar för att hålla hög kvalitet i det arbete du utför.

Vi tror också att du har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och att du har lätt för att samarbeta.

För oss är det viktigt att ha ett trevligt och glatt bemötande, både mot varandra såväl som kunderna samt att ha ett intresse för trädgårdar.

B-körkort är ett måste då vi använder bilar för att ta oss till våra kunder.

Du ska förutom svenska även kunna prata engelska då nästan all kommunikation sker på engelska, franska är självklart en bra merit.

Detta är heltidstjänst med tillsvidareanställning, inte ett sommarjobb.

Om detta kan vara av intresse, lägg en mail till oss på info@jardinriviera.com där du berättar om dig själv samt erfarenhet osv.

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig! ☀️🌴

Jardin Riviera

description:

? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.

? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.

? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.

title: Conseiller de vente - Boen sur Lignon F/H
description: Rattaché(e) à la Responsable d'agence, vous occupez un poste central dans l'accueil, le conseil et la satisfaction d'une clientèle composée de professionnels du bâtiment et de particuliers. À ce titre, vos principales missions sont les suivantes :Accueillir, conseiller et orienter les clients au comptoir et en showroom, en apportant un conseil technique adapté à leurs besoins.Réaliser les ventes, établir les devis, enregistrer les commandes et éditer les bons de livraison.Assurer le suivi des commandes clients et fournisseurs, en lien avec les équipes internes.Veiller à la bonne tenue de votre espace de vente et du showroom : mise en rayon, présentation des produits, organisation et propreté.Contribuer activement à la satisfaction et à la fidélisation des clients par un service de qualité et une relation de confiance durable.

title: Conseiller clientèle en ligne (F/H)
description: En tant qu'organisateur de forums de recrutement, Talents Handicap accompagne de très nombreuses entreprises & organisations en France dans leurs recrutements de collaborateurs en situation de handicap. Participant actuellement à l'un de nos forums. L'entreprise Caisse d'épargne Rhône Alpes recherche actuellement des profils : Banque régionale et coopérative, la Caisse d'Epargne Rhône Alpes est un acteur économique incontournable de la région.Elle accompagne l'ensemble de ses clients et contribue au développement durable de son territoire.Son engagement social et solidaire se traduit concrètement à travers des actions fortes en faveur de l'égalité des chances, de l'inclusion et de la diversité.Dans une démarche d'amélioration continue de l'expérience collaborateur, la Caisse d'Epargne Rhône Alpes obtient, dès sa première participation, la certification Great Place To Work, référence mondiale en matière de qualité de vie au travail.Cette distinction vient reconnaître l'engagement collectif des équipes ainsi que les actions menées pour favoriser un environnement de travail positif, au service de la performance.Poste et missions L'Agence en Ligne de Annecy, recherche un Conseiller clientèle en ligne (F/H).Vous apportez à vos clients un conseil adapté à leurs besoins, via les canaux distants et déterminez leur potentiel.Vous saisissez ainsi les opportunités pour exploiter et satisfaire leurs besoins dans le respect de la déontologie, des objectifs commerciaux et du développement du portefeuille géré en pool.Vos missions : - Vous développez et fidélisez, via des canaux distants, un portefeuille de clients particuliers, géré en pool, - Vous répondez aux sollicitations des clients à distance, - Vous participez à la gestion des réclamations et incidents, - Vous appliquez la politique commerciale et détectez le potentiel client, - Vous commercialisez l'offre Produits et Services, - Vous finalisez les actes de vente, assurez le montage, la maîtrise des risques et pérennisez la relation commerciale.Profil et compétences requises De formation Bac+2/3 minimum (diplôme obtenu ou niveau) dans une filière bancaire et/ou commerciale (ou niveau équivalent acquis par une expérience reconnue) : - Vous justifiez d'une expérience réussie en Banque, Assurance.- Vous maîtrisez les méthodes de vente et avez de bonnes connaissances juridiques et fiscales.- Votre sens de la relation commerciale, votre tempérament de développeur et votre capacité à maximiser la satisfaction client vous permettront d'évoluer rapidement vers des métiers d'expertise ou de management.- Votre appétence pour le digital sera un réel atout.Informations complémentaires Postes à pouvoir en CDI Salaire fixe proposé entre et € annuel brut (en fonction de l'expérience bancaire), plus éléments variables et avantages dont : Rémunération variable Intéressement Prime de vie chère (pour les offres concernées) Avantages tarifaires sur offres bancaires & assurances Semaine de 4,5 jours de travail Possibilité de télétravail La Caisse d'Epargne Rhône Alpes s'engage en faveur de l'accueil et de l'intégration des personnes en situation de handicap.

title: Technicien SAV Itinérant F/H
description: Rattaché(e) au service après-vente, vous intervenez directement sur les sites clients afin d'assurer la maintenance, le dépannage et la réparation du parc de chariots élévateurs. Garant de la satisfaction client, vous veillez à la performance et à la rentabilité de vos interventions.1. Maintenance technique & DépannageDiagnostiquer les pannes (mécaniques, hydrauliques, électriques/électroniques) et réaliser les réparations nécessaires sur le terrain.Maximiser le taux de disponibilité des équipements et garantir leur bon fonctionnement.Établir des pré-devis techniques (chiffrage du temps d'intervention et identification des pièces).2. Relation client & ConseilAccompagner et conseiller les clients sur l'utilisation optimale et la sécurité de leur matériel.Préconiser des travaux d'amélioration, de remise en état ou de mise en conformité.Être l'ambassadeur(drice) de l'entreprise grâce à une communication claire et professionnelle.3. Gestion administrative & OrganisationPlanifier vos déplacements en lien avec le service planning.Gérer et optimiser le stock de votre véhicule de service (outils, pièces détachées).Rédiger les comptes-rendus d'intervention précis sur tablette (pannes constatées, actions menées, pièces utilisées).Veiller au respect strict des consignes de sécurité, de qualité et d'environnement.

title: Manager Commerce Poissonnerie F/H
description:
Nous sommes.
Auchan Retail France, une entreprise de distribution de plus de collaborateurs au service de millions de clients chaque année.
Ce que nous voulons, c'est aider nos clients à bien manger et vivre mieux, tout en préservant la planète.
Que l'on soit en entrepôt, en magasin ou sur des fonctions support, notre point commun à tous, c'est de faire en sorte que nos clients aient plaisir à faire leurs courses chez nous.
Parce que nos collaborateurs sont aussi nos premiers clients, nous veillons chaque jour à leur bien-être et leur évolution professionnelle.
Vous avez envie de.

Manager une équipe passionnée et professionnelle, les aider à s'épanouir et à développer leurs compétences au travers d'une passion commune pour les produits de la mer.


Fidéliser vos clients, en garantissant leur satisfaction par votre étal, vos rayons et vos conseils (étiquetage, hygiène/propreté, traçabilité, théâtralisation...) au travers des produits de qualité supérieure et d'une large gamme de choix.


Dynamiser votre commerce, en mettant en place, avec vos équipes des partenariats (fournisseurs/éleveurs/producteurs locaux...) et des animations commerciales adaptées aux spécialités locales.


Garantir la performance de votre commerce, en analysant et pilotant les indicateurs commerciaux (CA, marges, démarques...) du compte d'exploitation. Activer les bons leviers (politique prix, budgets d'achats) et piloter vos stocks, approvisionnements et commandes.

Vous êtes.
Diplômé de niveau CAP/BEP/BP en Poissonnerie, vous avez une expérience de minimum 2 ans sur un poste similaire (Responsable rayon poissonnerie, Chef de rayon marée...). Passionné.e par les produits et la relation client, vous savez accompagner et gérer les chiffres d'un rayon.
Le poste de Manager Commerce Poissonnerie F/H (Niveau 7) est fait pour vous.
Rencontrons-nous !

title: Technician for lab management and user support
description:
Technician for lab management and user support

CONTEXT:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) is an international centre for scientific research situated in Grenoble, France. It is Europe's leading neutron science facility. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research in a wide variety of scientific fields. The Biology, Deuteration, Chemistry and Soft Matter (BDCS) group operates the Chemistry and Soft Matter support laboratories, which offer equipment, lab space and support for sample preparation and characterisation, serving both external users and in-house scientists. The BDCS group also operates the Lipid and Deuteration laboratories, which are equipped with state-of-the-art instrumentation for the production and characterisation of tailor-made deuterated biological molecules for the ILL user community.

YOUR TASKS:
In the context of the European FEDER EPN-AVENIR-ILL project and the arrival of new laboratory equipment in the BDCS group, you will reinforce the team in the management of the different labs, support the users with their scientific projects, including the activities of the ILL Science Hubs, and liaise between the members of the group. You will welcome and interact with users before, during and after their stay, assist with operating equipment, and help with sample preparation. Your activities will include:
. Supporting the scientists and lab managers by communicating with, welcoming and assisting users with their scientific projects in the different labs
. Management of laboratory supplies and stocks, and regular calibration of lab equipment
. Organisation of lab space and equipment, as well as participation in waste management and the chemical inventory
. Supporting the Lipid Lab staff with the user programme, in particular with running the chromatography equipment (HPLC, GC, TLC,.), including the new FEDER equipment
. The successful candidate will interact with various actors at ILL, including members of the BDCS group, safety engineers, technicians, as well as ILL users and external companies.

YOUR PROFILE:
You have a Level 5 qualification (HND or equivalent) in chemistry (or biochemistry)
. Expertise in the operation of standard (bio-)chemistry laboratory equipment
. Sound knowledge of laboratory safety rules and regulations
. Autonomy and good communication skills
. Experience of working in a research facility, in industry or at a large-scale research infrastructure would be an asset
. You must have a sound knowledge of written and spoken English. Knowledge of French would be a plus (a language course could be paid for by the ILL)

QUALITY OF LIFE:
This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

title: Marketing Manager – Marchés francophones (H/F/D) (Marketingfachkraft/-assistent/in)
description:
SOFiSTiK AG est une PME allemande spécialisée dans le développement de solutions logicielles innovantes pour le secteur de la construction. Nos solutions accompagnent les professionnels du bâtiment, des ouvrages d’art, du génie civil et des infrastructures dans la conception, l’analyse et le dimensionnement de leurs projets à travers le monde.

SOFiSTiK France, implantée à Paris depuis 2021, accompagne le développement du groupe sur les marchés francophones en Europe et en Afrique. En complément de la commercialisation des solutions SOFiSTiK, notre équipe apporte aux clients une expertise technique locale et un accompagnement de proximité adapté aux spécificités de leurs marchés.

Rejoindre SOFiSTiK, c’est évoluer dans une entreprise technologique à taille humaine et à dimension internationale, où l’autonomie, la collaboration et le partage des connaissances occupent une place importante.

Dans le cadre du développement de nos activités sur les marchés francophones, nous recherchons un(e) Marketing Manager pour piloter et développer nos actions marketing locales, en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe française et l’équipe Marketing internationale.

Marketing Manager – Marchés francophones (H/F/D)

CDI – Temps partiel ou temps plein

Poste basé à Paris (Télétravail possible)

Vos missions

- Piloter et développer les activités marketing sur le marché francophone, en adaptant la stratégie marketing internationale aux besoins et spécificités locales.
- Développer la visibilité et la notoriété de SOFiSTiK auprès des publics cibles, notamment à travers LinkedIn, le site web et des campagnes digitales.
- Concevoir et déployer des campagnes marketing visant à générer de l'engagement et des opportunités commerciales, en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales.
- Créer, adapter et optimiser les contenus marketing en français : contenus web, newsletters, brochures, campagnes, témoignages clients et autres supports.
- Planifier et coordonner les webinaires, salons et événements destinés aux marchés francophones, de la conception à la promotion et au suivi.
- Analyser les performances des actions marketing et identifier les leviers permettant d'améliorer leur impact et leur contribution aux objectifs commerciaux.
- Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe Marketing internationale du siège afin d'adapter les campagnes, contenus et initiatives globales au marché francophone.
- Être l'interface Marketing avec les équipes commerciales et les autres parties prenantes locales, afin d'identifier les besoins du marché et de soutenir le développement commercial.

Profil recherché

- Formation supérieure en marketing, communication, médias ou domaine équivalent.
- 3 ans minimum d’expérience professionnelle en marketing, idéalement dans un environnement B2B, en entreprise ou en agence.
- Esprit analytique et orientation résultats, avec une capacité à suivre les performances des actions marketing et à identifier des pistes d’optimisation
- Capacité à piloter des actions marketing de manière autonome, de leur conception à leur mise en œuvre et à l’analyse des résultats.
- Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles et sensibilité aux contenus et à la communication digitale.
- Expérience et forte appétence pour les campagnes digitales, les réseaux sociaux et l’organisation d’événements/webinaires.
- Capacité à travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes commerciales et bonne compréhension des enjeux de génération et de gestion des leads.
- Excellente maîtrise du français, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, avec de très bonnes qualités rédactionnelles.
- Très bonne maîtrise de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral (niveau B2 minimum), permettant de travailler efficacement dans un environnement international.  
- La connaissance de l'allemand constitue un atout.
- La connaissance d’outils CRM et/ou de marketing automation (Microsoft Dynamics, HubSpot, etc.) constitue un atout.

Vos qualités

- Autonomie, rigueur et sens de l’organisation.
- Capacité à gérer plusieurs projets et priorités simultanément
- Excellent relationnel et aisance à collaborer avec des interlocuteurs variés dans un environnement international.
- Esprit d'équipe, curiosité et proactivité.

Ce que nous proposons

- Un rôle varié et autonome, avec la possibilité de prendre des initiatives, de proposer vos idées et de contribuer concrètement au développement de SOFiSTiK sur le marché francophone.
- Un accompagnement structuré dès votre arrivée, pour vous familiariser avec nos solutions, notre marché et nos équipes.
- Un environnement de travail international, collaboratif et à taille humaine, avec des échanges réguliers avec les équipes Marketing et commerciales en France et à l’international.
- Des possibilités de formation et de développement professionnel, en fonction de votre expérience et de vos ambitions.
- Une organisation favorisant l’équilibre entre vie professionnelle et vie personnelle, avec des horaires flexibles et la possibilité de télétravailler selon les modalités en vigueur.
- Une rémunération attractive complétée par des avantages sociaux (mutuelle, …).

Candidature

Merci d'adresser votre candidature (CV et lettre de motivation) par e-mail à :

jobs@sofistik.com

Nous étudierons votre candidature avec attention et reviendrons vers vous dans les meilleurs délais afin d'échanger ensemble sur votre parcours et vos motivations.

title: Trädgårdsunderhåll Trädgårdmästare Trädgårdsarbetare
description:
Vår franska trädgårdsfirma, Jardin Riviera, utgår utanför Nice på Franska Rivieran och arbetar i ett område på cirka 30 km.

Vi söker mer personal med heltidstjänst på tillsvidareanställning då vi har mer än fullt upp med våra projekt i olika trädgårdar.

Under vinterhalvåret bygger vi mycket trädgårdar och under sommarhalvåret är det underhåll som gäller. Vi utför i stort sett alla arbetsuppgifter som uppkommer i en trädgård.

Ni kan läsa mer om företaget och hur vi jobbar på vår hemsida www.jardinriviera.com

Vi behöver en morgonpigg, positiv och glad person som gillar att ta del av teamets kunskaper och vår service.

Du är proaktiv, ansvarstagande, har god lyssningsförmåga, visar nyfikenhet och är bra på att interagera och planera ditt arbete.

Vi letar efter dig som sätter ett värde i att utföra arbetet på bästa möjliga vis och som inte är rädd för att hugga i när och där det behövs.

För att lyckas och trivas i tjänsten behöver du vara serviceinriktad och ta ansvar för att hålla hög kvalitet i det arbete du utför.

Vi tror också att du har förmågan att arbeta självständigt och att du har lätt för att samarbeta.

För oss är det viktigt att ha ett trevligt och glatt bemötande, både mot varandra såväl som kunderna samt att ha ett intresse för trädgårdar.

B-körkort är ett måste då vi använder bilar för att ta oss till våra kunder.

Du ska förutom svenska även kunna prata engelska då nästan all kommunikation sker på engelska, franska är självklart en bra merit.

Detta är heltidstjänst med tillsvidareanställning, inte ett sommarjobb.

Om detta kan vara av intresse, lägg en mail till oss på info@jardinriviera.com där du berättar om dig själv samt erfarenhet osv.

Vi ser fram emot att höra ifrån dig! ☀️🌴

Jardin Riviera

title: Sähkö- / tietoliikennealan osaaja projektitöihin ulkomaille, (vakituinen)
description:
Etsimme asentajaa mukaan kansainvälisiin kaapelointiprojekteihin!

Mikäli olet kiinnostunut työskentelemään erilaisissa datakeskusprojekteissa ympäri Eurooppaa ja välillä myös pidemmälläkin, etkä vieroksu pitkiä työpäiviä, saatat olla sopiva henkilö haettuun tehtävään.

Haemme luotettavaa ja oma-aloitteista asentajaa vakituiseen ja kokoaikaiseen työsuhteeseen. Työ on projektiluontoista, ja projektit sijaitsevat pääsääntöisesti ulkomailla, suurimmaksi osaksi Euroopassa.

Tehtävässä pääset työskentelemään erilaisissa kaapelointi- ja asennusprojekteissa kansainvälisessä työympäristössä. Työ sopii henkilölle, joka on valmis matkustamaan työn perässä ja sitoutumaan ulkomailla työskentelyyn projektien tarpeiden mukaisesti.

Työtehtävät:

Työtehtävät koostuvat erilaisista kaapelointi- ja asennustöistä. Tehtävät vaihtelevat projektin mukaan. Työhön saat kattavan perehdytyksen, joten kaikkea ei tarvitse osata valmiiksi. Aikaisempi kokemus asennustyyppisistä tehtävistä on kuitenkin eduksi.

Odotamme sinulta:

\- Luotettavuutta ja vastuullista työotetta

\- Oma-aloitteisuutta ja reipasta asennetta työn tekemiseen

\- Valmiutta matkustaa ja työskennellä ulkomailla

\- Kykyä sitoutua projektiluontoiseen työskentelyyn

\- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä tehtävässä

\- Hyviä yhteistyötaitoja ja paineensietokykyä

Työssä menestymistä tukee esimerkiksi sähköasentajan koulutus tai aikaisempi kokemus sähkö-, kaapelointi-, rakennus- tai muista asennustöistä. Perehdytämme sinut työtehtäviin, joten tärkeintä on oikea asenne, luotettavuus ja halu oppia.

Mitä tarjoamme?

\- Vakituinen ja kokoaikainen työsuhde

\- Kansainvälisiä työprojekteja pääasiassa Euroopassa

\- Kattavan perehdytyksen tehtävään

\- Mahdollisuuden kehittää omaa ammattitaitoa

- Unterstützung bei Montage- und Demontagearbeiten im Bereich BA 1
- Vorbereitung von Materialien, Werkzeugen und Bauteilen für die Montage
- Unterstützung beim Aufbau, Einbau und der Befestigung von Bauteilen und Konstruktionen

- Durchführung von Fahrten zu Einsatzorten, sofern erforderlich

- Sicherstellung von Sauberkeit, Ordnung und Einhaltung der Sicherheitsvorschriften
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Monteuren und dem zuständigen Team

Wichtige Anforderungen:

- Erfahrung im Bereich Montage ist erforderlich
- Fähigkeit zum Lesen technischer Zeichnungen ist von Vorteil
- Erfahrung in der Bedienung von Hebebühnen und Staplern ist von Vorteil
- Bereitschaft zu Montageeinsätzen im In- und Ausland (in projektbedingten Ausnahmefällen auch am Wochenende)
- Gültige Arbeitserlaubnis für die EU

- Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Grundverständnis
- Körperliche Belastbarkeit sowie eine qualitätsbewusste und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

title: Security guard
description:
Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.

Under the responsibility of the Head of the Site Security and Protection Service (SSP), which is part of the ILL's Reactor Division, you will help to ensure the safety and security of persons and property on the site. You will assist in the surveillance of the various secured areas on the ILL site and will work in collaboration with the shift teams in the reactor control room.

Your tasks:
? Perform CCTV site surveillance and alarm handling.
? Perform surveillance on the installations.
? Initiate and guide specialist emergency or intervention teams.
? Issue site access and carry out entry and exit controls at different locations.
? Conduct security patrols.
? Act as a first responder in the event of a fire and liaise with external emergency services.
? Take action upon request by the emergency services or provide assistance to victims.
? Perform various alarm verifications.
? Process and relay site-security-related information and fill in the service logbook.
? Take part in the periodic tests and inspections for which the Site Security and Protection Service is responsible.
? Facilitate access as appropriate to the different zones for visitors, researchers and scientists within the responsibility of the SSP.

Your profile:
? You have a Level 3/4 qualification ('A' level equivalent) in the field of security.
? You hold a valid private security guard licence (CNAPS licence, SIA licence or equivalent).
? You have solid professional experience in the emergency services (for example, the military, police or fire service), or in the private or public security sector.
? You are dynamic and meticulous, follow rules and respect your manager. You thrive on teamwork and demonstrate a high degree of adaptability.
? You have no difficulty using computer technology or monitoring technology (screens) required for the job.
? You are able to handle stress and remain in control of yourself at all times.
? You are able to apply the appropriate procedures and instructions, but can also show initiative and discerning judgment.
? An intermediate level of English is desirable. Sound knowledge of French is required.

What we offer
Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a secure permanent position based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online via our career portal by 01/11/2026, quoting reference number 26/45. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness (including for work under ionising radiation) is required. You will also have to perform an emergency response role in the event of a crisis. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.
