title: Sjúkraþjálfari - Physiotherapist
description:
Physiotherapist – Akureyri Hospital

We are looking for a physiotherapist to join our excellent team at Akureyri Hospital (SAk). This is a 75–100% permanent position, available immediately or by mutual agreement.
Physiotherapists at Akureyri Hospital work in the hospital’s acute care departments at Eyrarlandsvegur and/or in the rehabilitation department. Following the relocation of the rehabilitation department from Kristnes, rehabilitation services will now be provided in two locations: an inpatient rehabilitation unit at SAk’s facility at Eyrarlandsholt, and a day and outpatient rehabilitation unit outside the hospital. The service will provide multidisciplinary rehabilitation both individually and in groups. The location of the position may depend on the applicant’s interests and area of expertise.
The position is primarily daytime work. The current working week for full-time employees is 36 hours. Occasional weekend and public holiday shifts in the hospital’s acute care departments are also required. These shifts are paid separately and provide additional earning opportunities.
The position is varied and offers excellent opportunities to develop professional and specialised knowledge and to participate in the development of a day and outpatient rehabilitation service at a new location. We warmly welcome new colleagues and provide a comprehensive induction supported by experienced physiotherapists. This is an excellent opportunity for both experienced physiotherapists and newly qualified professionals to deepen their knowledge and become part of a strong and supportive team.

Main Duties and Responsibilities
•    General physiotherapy practice in a multidisciplinary environment
•    Providing education and guidance to patients and their families
•    Multidisciplinary collaboration within hospital departments
•    Duties and responsibilities will be tailored to the applicant’s experience
•    Participation in professional development

Qualifications and Requirements
•    A recognised qualification in physiotherapy and a valid Icelandic professional licence (we will assist applicants in applying for icelandic license)
•    In the recruitment process, emphasis will be placed on professional knowledge, experience and interest, independence in working methods, and strong communication and teamwork skills
•    Applicants must demonstrate integrity and professionalism, including a good reputation and conduct, both inside and outside the workplace, that is compatible with the requirements of the position
•    A clean criminal record

Further Information
Salary is in accordance with the current collective agreement between the Minister of Finance and Economic Affairs and the Icelandic Association of Physiotherapists.
All applications must be submitted electronically through the Icelandic government’s recruitment system. Applications should include detailed information about education and employment history, as well as copies of diplomas/certificates and professional licences, where applicable.
Akureyri Hospital’s equality policy is taken into consideration when recruiting staff. title: Erä- ja luonto opas tai muu luontomatkailualan ammattilainen
description:
**Etsin lisää luontomatkailualan ammattilaisia yhteistyöhön kanssani ja osaksi yritykseni Wild Adventures North kasvutarinaa.**

Wild Adventures North on erikoistunut järjestämään villejä seikkailuja suomalaiselle kohderyhmälle. Tarjoamme 10 vuoden kokemuksella autenttisen eräkokemuksen sen kaikessa karuudessaan ja kauneudessaan.

Elämyksiä suunnittelee ja toteuttaa yhteistyössä alan ammattilaisista koostuva tiimi. Toiminta-alueemme kattaa Suomen, Ruotsin ja Norjan upeimmat luontokohteet.

Meille luonnossa liikkuminen on enemmän kuin siirtymistä paikasta toiseen - se on oppimista oivaltamista a yhteyttä ympäröivään luontoon, Opetamme asiakkaalle kaiken, mitä hän tarvitsee - ja vähän enemmänkin.

Tarjontamme on omassa kategoriassaan Suomen laajin: valikoimaamme kuuluu jo 69 erilaista patikka- hiihto-, melonta-, juoksu-, lumikenkä- ja jäätikkövaellusta sekä selviytymiskoulutusta. Meidän kanssamme asiakas voi esimerkiksi:

- vaeltaa koko Suomen Lapin halki kaikkien 12 erämaan läpi

- nousta Suomen korkeimmalle tunturille - ja huiputtaa pikavaellustyylillä kaikki Suomen 33 yli 1000-metristä tunturia

- saavuttaa Suomen ja Ruotsin erämaisimmat pisteet meloa packraftilla niin sileässä vedessä kuin kuohuvissa koskissakin suorittaa Suomen vaativimman kaupallisen selviytymiskokeen, jossa hänet eksytetään helikopterilla viikoksi erämaahan ilman ruokaa, telttaa ja makuupussia - ja käydä ensin siihen valmistavan koulutuspolun

- vaeltaa Pohjois-Norjan jäätikköerämaassa köysistössä, jääraudat jalassa ja hakku kädessä


Yritykseni lähivuosien tavoitteena on laajentaa;

- toiminta uusiin maihin

- markkinointi suomalaisille yrityksille ja lapsiperheille

- elämystarjonta uusiin lajeihin


Jos sinulla on kompetenssia ja ideaa tarttua johonkin näistä kolmesta tavoitteesta, saatat olla etsimäni ammattilainen.

Yhteistyö kanssani tarkoittaa sitä, että olemme yhdessä laatineet välillemme yhteistyösopimuksen, joka mm. määrittelee roolit, tehtävät, vastuun ja potin iaon. Olet yrittäjä, joka laskuttaa yritystäni palveluistaan.

Yhteistyössä kanssani on eri tasoja. Voit olla vieraileva opas, joka tekee yhden tai useamman yksittäisen keikan. Tai voit olla kiinteä osa brändini suojeluksessa toimivaa opastiimiä, joka suunnittelee, testaa ja toteuttaa uusia elämyksiä

Yhteistyö kanssani on kannattavaa, jos et halua rakentaa uutta luontomatkailubisnestä tyhjästä. Pääset hyötymään yritykseni 10 vuoden ajan rakennetusta laajasta asiakaspoolista, näkyvyydestä, vakiintuneesta markkina-asemasta, ryhmäkalustosta ja tiimin vertaistuesta.

Odotan yhteydenottoasi!

Sjúkraþjálfarar við Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri starfa á bráðadeildum sjúkrahússins við Eyrarlandsveg og/eða á endurhæfingadeild. Vegna flutninga endurhæfingardeildar af Kristnesi verður nú annars vegar starfrækt legudeild endurhæfingar í húsnæði SAk á Eyrarlandsholti og hins vegar dag- og göngudeild utan spítalans. Þar mun fara fram þverfagleg endurhæfing á einstaklingsgrunni og/eða í hópum. Staðsetning starfs getur farið eftir áhugasviði umsækjenda.

Um er að ræða dagvinnu, vinnuvika starfsfólks í fullu starfi er nú 36 klst. Við það bætast stöku sinnum vaktir um helgar og á lögbundnum frídögum við bráðadeildir sjúkrahússins, sem greitt er aukalega fyrir og gefur aukna tekjumöguleika.

Starfið er fjölbreytt og býður upp á frábær tækifæri til að afla sér faglegrar og sérhæfðrar þekkingar og taka þátt í uppbyggingu dag- og göngudeildar á nýjum stað. Við tökum vel á móti nýju fólki og veitum góða aðlögun undir handleiðslu reyndra sjúkraþjálfara. Kjörið tækifæri fyrir reynslubolta sem og nýútskrifaða til að dýpka þekkingu og verða hluti af öflugri liðsheild.

Helstu verkefni og ábyrgð
Almenn vinna sjúkraþjálfara í þverfaglegu umhverfi

Fræðsla til sjúklinga og aðstandenda

Þverfaglegt samstarf innan deilda

Verkefni og ábyrgð eru í samræmi við reynslu

Þátttaka í faglegri þróun

Hæfniskröfur
Fullgilt próf í sjúkraþjálfun og íslenskt starfsleyfi

Við ráðningu verður lögð áhersla á faglega þekkingu, reynslu og áhuga, sjálfstæði í vinnubrögðum og hæfileika í samskiptum og samvinnu

Gerð er krafa um vammleysi, s.s. að vera með gott orðspor og að framkoma og athafnir á vinnustað og utan hans samrýmist starfinu

Hreint sakavottorð

Frekari upplýsingar um starfið
Laun samkvæmt gildandi kjarasamningi sem fjármála- og efnahagsráðherra og Félag sjúkraþjálfara hafa gert.

Allar umsóknir þurfa að fara rafrænt í gegnum ráðningarkerfi ríkisins. Umsóknum skulu fylgja ítarlegar upplýsingar um nám og starfsferilskrá ásamt afriti af prófskírteinum og starfsleyfi, ef við á. Tekið er mið af jafnréttisstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri við ráðningar í störf á sjúkrahúsinu. Umsóknir geta gilt í 6 mánuði frá birtingu auglýsingar, sbr. 3. tl. 2. mgr. 2. gr. reglna nr. 1000/2019 um auglýsingar lausra starfa með síðari breytingum. Öllum umsóknum verður svarað.

Sjúkrahúsið á Akureyri veitir alþjóðlega DNV-GL vottaða heilbrigðisþjónustu með ISO vottuðu gæðastjórnunarkerfi þar sem áhersla er á virka þátttöku allra starfsmanna til að uppfylla þær gæðakröfur sem gerðar eru í alþjóðlegum staðli sem sjúkrahúsið er vottað eftir.

Samkvæmt mannauðsstefnu Sjúkrahússins á Akureyri er lögð áhersla á að ráða til starfa og halda í hæfileikaríka einstaklinga. Við val á starfsfólki er menntun, reynsla, færni og hæfni höfð að leiðarljósi. Mannauðsstefnan er leiðarljós stjórnenda og starfsfólks sem gerir sjúkrahúsið framsækinn og eftirsóknarverðan vinnustað, en hún byggir á grunngildum sjúkrahússins sem eru: ÖRYGGI, SAMVINNA og FRAMSÆKNI.

title: Join Landspítali as a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine in Iceland
description:
We are seeking a Consultant in Respiratory Medicine to join Landspítali University Hospital, with a start date of 1 November 2026 or as otherwise agreed.
The position is full-time; however, a lower employment ratio may be considered by mutual agreement.

Our Department of Pulmonary Medicine consists of a strong and ambitious team of physicians managing a broad range of clinical responsibilities in close collaboration with other healthcare professionals. We are looking for a dedicated and motivated specialist who wishes to contribute to highly specialised care and follow-up of patients with respiratory diseases.

Why Join Landspítali?

At Landspítali, we offer:
•    A stimulating and rewarding consultant-level position at Iceland's national university hospital, with diverse and interesting clinical responsibilities.
•    A 36-hour work week that supports a healthy work-life balance.
•    Close collaboration with experienced multidisciplinary teams and specialists across a range of clinical disciplines.
•    An academic environment where clinical practice, research, teaching, and innovation go hand in hand.
•    A supportive workplace that values staff wellbeing, professional development, and continuous learning.
•    Opportunities to learn Icelandic, including language courses offered partly during working hours during the first two years of employment.
•    The opportunity to live and work in Iceland and enjoy a high quality of life in a safe and well-functioning society.
•    Easy access to spectacular nature, clean air, and year-round outdoor activities, including hiking, skiing, geothermal bathing, and unique natural experiences.

Duties and Responsibilities
•    Care of patients on hospital wards and in the intensive care unit.
•    Outpatient clinics and day-ward services involving a broad range of pulmonary conditions, including but not limited to:
   o    Interstitial lung diseases
   o    Severe asthma
   o    Lung cancer diagnostics and follow up
   o    Advanced COPD and other late-stage obstructive lung diseases
   o    Acute and chronic respiratory failure
   o    Home mechanical ventilation and other ventilatory support therapies
•    Performance of interventional procedures, including:
   o    Bronchoscopy
   o    Pleural procedures/thoracentesis
   o    Exercise testing (cardiopulmonary excercise testing)
•    Participation in the pulmonary medicine on-call service.
•    Participation in acute internal medicine services, including on-call duties, as agreed with the Head of Pulmonary Medicine.
•    Teaching and supervision of medical students, intern/foundation doctors, and specialty trainees.
•    Participation in research activities.
•    Other duties as agreed with the Head of Department.

Qualifications
•    Specialist certification in Pulmonology/Respiratory Medicine.
•    Icelandic medical licence and specialist recognition in Pulmonology, or eligibility to obtain these credentials.
•    Broad knowledge and experience in Internal Medicine and Pulmonology.
•    Proven ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary teams.
•    Positive attitude, flexibility, and strong collaborative skills.
•    Experience in teaching and research is considered an advantage.

Additional Information
A full-time position is exclusively affiliated with the hospital in accordance with Article 3.3 of the current collective agreement between physicians and the Icelandic State.

The position is available from 1 November 2026 or by mutual agreement. The application deadline is 23 October 2026.

For further information, please contact:
Sif Hansdóttir, Consultant Physician
E-mail: sifhan@landspitali.is

Application Requirements
Applications should include information on:
•    Previous employment, education, and professional qualifications
•    Positions of trust and references

Mandatory Attachments
•    Certified copies of degree certificates and specialist qualifications/licences
•    Curriculum Vitae (CV), including teaching, research, and leadership experience
•    List of scientific publications in peer-reviewed journals. Applicants should either provide a link to their Google Scholar profile or submit publication documentation from PubMed.
•    Cover letter describing the applicant's qualifications and interest in the position

All attachments must be submitted in PDF format.

Selected candidates will be invited for interviews. Appointment decisions will be based on interviews and submitted documentation. Recruitment is conducted in accordance with Landspítali's Equal Opportunities Policy. All applicants will be informed of the outcome of the recruitment process.

Information regarding residence and work permits is available on our website.
To apply for the position, click the dark blue button "Sækja um starf" (Apply for Position). You may then switch the website language to English and log in to the Icelandic Government's recruitment system.

About Landspítali
Landspítali is a dynamic and diverse workplace where approximately 7,000 employees work in multidisciplinary teams and in close collaboration across professional groups. The hospital's vision is to provide healthcare of the highest quality, based on science, professionalism, and compassion, delivered by skilled staff and supported by modern facilities and a positive working environment.
Landspítali is certified according to the Icelandic Equal Pay Standard ÍST 85:2012. The certification has been awarded following an audit conducted by Versa Vottun ehf.

Applications may remain valid for up to six months from the publication date of the advertisement, in accordance with Icelandic Government Regulation No. 1000/2019 on the advertisement of vacant public positions, as amended.

The policy of Tusla Child and Family Agency is to enable children / young people to live with their own families wherever possible and to support parents where necessary in fulfilling that role. The Social Care Worker will provide care, protection, and support to vulnerable or dependent clients, individually or in groups, in conjunction with the wider multidisciplinary team and other relevant agencies. The primary aim is to provide intervention necessary to address the child / young person’s issues or the issues that are preventing them from living at home or in relative / foster care. S/he will ensure the welfare of those under his/her care and will act as an advocate as appropriate. Social Care Workers in a Residential setting work as part of a multidisciplinary team to provide care to service users. Children / young people may be referred to a residential setting for a number of reasons by the Social Work department e.g. family breakdown / separation, history of neglect, sexual / physical abuse, addiction or mental health issues. Residential care aims to provide a therapeutic care placement to service users who most often present with emotional or behavioural difficulties and cannot live with their own families. Chi siamo: Gi Group è la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà, a livello mondiale, nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. Il Gruppo è attivo nei seguenti campi: lavoro temporaneo, permanent e professional staffing, ricerca e selezione, consulenza HR e formazione, outsourcing, supporto alla ricollocazione e attività complementari. Grazie al percorso di internazionalizzazione, iniziato nel 2007, oggi Gi Group opera, direttamente o con partnership strategiche, in oltre 57 paesi in Europa, America, Asia e Africa. Il Gruppo è anche un Global Corporate Member di WEC - World Employment Confederation - la Confederazione Internazionale delle agenzie per il lavoro. Nel 2018 ha servito più di 20.000 aziende con un fatturato di oltre 2.3 miliardi di Euro nel mondo. description: Il nostro Cliente, rappresentativa azienda operante nel settore della componentistica in metallo per il settore automotive, truck ed elettrodomestico ci ha incaricato di ricercare: SALES MANAGER Il Candidato avrà la responsabilità di sviluppare e consolidare il business aziendale, gestendo i rapporti con clienti, partner e stakeholder del settore, individuando nuove opportunità commerciali e contribuendo alla crescita dell'azienda. Principali Responsabilità - Gestire e sviluppare il portafoglio clienti assegnato, con particolare focus su clienti strategici del settore automotive, sia in ambito nazionale che internazionale. - Individuare nuove opportunità di business e sviluppare relazioni commerciali di lungo periodo con nuovi clienti e partner industriali. - Condurre trattative commerciali complesse, dalla fase di primo contatto fino alla negoziazione e chiusura degli accordi, assicurando il raggiungimento degli obiettivi di vendita. - Mantenere e sviluppare relazioni con decision maker e stakeholder chiave delle aziende clienti, consolidando una rete di contatti strategici nel settore. - Collaborare con le funzioni interne (engineering, produzione, qualità e supply chain) per garantire la corretta industrializzazione dei progetti e l'allineamento tra esigenze del cliente e capacità produttive aziendali. - Supportare la definizione delle strategie commerciali e contribuire alla pianificazione delle attività di sviluppo del mercato - Monitorare l'andamento del mercato, dei competitor e delle tendenze del settore automotive, fornendo analisi e report periodici. - Partecipare a fiere, eventi di settore e incontri con clienti in Italia e all'estero. Requisiti - Diploma e/o Laurea ad indirizzo tecnico - Esperienza consolidata maturata in ruoli analoghi (Sales Manager, Account Manager, Key Account Manager) in aziende strutturate, possibilmente in ambito internazionale, del settore automotive. - Utilizzo dei principali tools informatici - Ottima conoscenza della lingua Inglese e di una seconda lingua tra francese e/o tedesco. - Approccio proattivo al mercato di riferimento e spiccata attitudine allo sviluppo del business - Capacità negoziali, capacità di ascolto e di analisi dei bisogni dei clienti - Attitudine relazionale e comunicativa con stakeholders a differenti livelli - Capacità di lavorare in team, orientamento al risultato e leadership ne completano il profilo. Sede di lavoro di riferimento: Veneto Centrale con disponibilità a svolgere trasferte/spostamenti presso le sedi dei clienti ubicate prevalentemente in Europa. title: assistente alle risorse umane
description: Grafton Office è la specializzazione di Gi Group dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali di Roma più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda che si occupa della gestione della rete di distribuzione elettrica, privata, pubblica e dell'illuminazione artistica di Roma, è alla ricerca di una risorsa da inserire all'interno dell'unità organizzativa delle Risorse Umane per il ruolo di: Specialista Relazioni Sindacali, Organizzazione e Costo del Lavoro Di cosa ti dovrai occupare? Analisi, supporto e gestione dei principali processi HR a supporto del business; Supportare la gestione delle relazioni sindacali e delle attività connesse alla contrattazione aziendale; Monitorare l'evoluzione della normativa del lavoro e dei contratti collettivi, fornendo supporto alle strutture aziendali sui temi giuslavoristici; Collaborare nella gestione di procedimenti disciplinari, contenziosi e problematiche inerenti al rapporto di lavoro; Supportare le attività di pianificazione degli organici e monitoraggio del costo del lavoro, attraverso l'elaborazione di analisi, report e indicatori HR; Collaborare alla predisposizione di budget, forecast e reportistica a supporto dei processi decisionali aziendali; Partecipare a progetti di sviluppo organizzativo, analizzando strutture, ruoli e processi e contribuendo alla definizione di soluzioni organizzative coerenti con le esigenze di business; Supportare le attività di aggiornamento del sistema normativo interno e della documentazione organizzativa aziendale. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Hai interesse per il mondo HR e per i processi organizzativi; Conosci la normativa del lavoro e la contrattazione aziendale di primo e secondo livello; Hai attitudine all'analisi, alla precisione e all'attenzione al dettaglio; Sei capace di lavorare in team e di relazionarti con interlocutori diversi; Possiedi buone capacità comunicative e organizzative; Hai capacità di negoziazione e gestione del conflitto; Sai utilizzare gli strumenti informatici di uso comune, in particolare il pacchetto Microsoft Office. Offerta Contrattuale: L'azienda propone un contratto a tempo determinato di 12 mesi in somministrazione, CCNL Elettrico, fascia di RAL 44.000 - 49.000€; premio di risultato aziendale, convertibile in welfare o previdenza complementare; straordinari retribuiti. Flessibilità oraria e smart working secondo accordi aziendali. Buoni pasto di € 12,80 per ogni giorno lavorativo; Luogo di lavoro: Roma, zona Ostiense. title: operatore di catene di montaggio automatizzate/operatrice di catene di montaggio automatizzate
description: Ti piace lavorare in squadra? Vuoi essere parte integrante del processo produttivo? Noi di Gi Group, filiale di SALERNO, cerchiamo per azienda cliente del settore settore elettrotecnico/industriale dei cavi: OPERAI PRODUZIONE CAVI Di cosa ti dovrai occupare? Preparazione della linea: predisposizione bobine/rocchetti, caricamento materie prime (conduttori, isolanti/guaina), set-up base e cambio formato seguendo le istruzioni del conduttore. Avviamento e conduzione in affiancamento: supporto durante start/stop, controllo che il materiale scorra correttamente, segnalazione anomalie (strappi, fuori misura, difetti superficiali). Controlli qualità in linea: verifiche semplici e registrazioni (es. diametro/spessore, continuità visiva, etichettatura, lunghezze), con eventuale isolamento del non conforme. Gestione bobine e movimentazione: sostituzione bobine finite, predisposizione nuove bobine, imballo/legatura, identificazione lotti e tracciabilità (etichette/ordine di produzione). Pulizia e manutenzione ordinaria: riordino post-lavorazione, pulizia area e componenti, piccole attività di routine (lubrificazione/controlli base) e segnalazione guasti alla manutenzione. Sicurezza e procedure: uso DPI, rispetto procedure HSE, attenzione a parti in movimento e carichi; collaborazione nel passaggio consegne tra turni. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Esperienza pregressa in linea di produzione Affidabilità e precisione. Attenzione a sicurezza, qualità e ordine. Spirito di collaborazione e rispetto delle regole. Flessibilità, capacità di adattarsi a ritmi produttivi variabili Ti rivedi in queste caratteristiche? Candidati ora! Orario di lavoro: Full-Time 40h dal lunedì al venerdì Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto di somministrazione a tempo determinato. CCNL applicato: Gomma e Plastica Industria Livello di inquadramento: liv. I Retribuzione prevista: 25000k Luogo di lavoro: SALERNO Diventa parte fondamentale di un reparto produttivo! title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per iniziativa -in ambito Space Economy- supportata da una holding di un investitore attivo nell'energy, con forte focus sulla crescita e lo sviluppo, ricerchiamo un/una: Product & Solution Manager IoT (Satellite Connectivity & Wholesale) Il core del ruolo sarà costruire e creare sinergie commerciali a mercato per l'offerta satellite-enabled della venture. Ossia servizi per il monitoraggio e la tracciabilità di asset e sistemi (IoT/asset tracking/remote monitoring) e una linea di business di connettività satellitare in logica wholesale (offerte rivendibili tramite partner, con livelli di servizio e prezzi chiari). La persona lavorerà a stretto contatto con il founder space per trasformare i bisogni dei clienti in scelte di prodotto e di servizio (copertura, prestazioni attese, priorità di sviluppo). Requisiti - Esperienza solida in product/solution management, business development o solution selling su servizi satellitari e/o soluzioni IoT abilitate dal satellite. - Capacità di valutare la sostenibilità di un'offerta in termini di copertura, livelli di servizio, vincoli operativi e pricing (approccio concreto, orientato al mercato). - Esperienza o forte attitudine al wholesale: creazione di offerte rivendibili e gestione di ecosistemi partner/reseller. - Familiarità con soluzioni IoT e modelli digitali (piattaforme, subscription, integrazioni). - Esperienza in ambito CubeSat (anche lato prodotto/servizio o go-to-market). - Laurea in Ingegneria (Aerospaziale/TLC/Informatica/Elettronica) o Gestionale Location: Milano, Italia Package: RAL 70-100K€ + benefit Contratto: CCNL Commercio #LI-CP Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. description: Hai una mente analitica e ti appassiona lavorare con i dati? Cerchi lavoro in ambito finanziario? Grafton Office è la specializzazione dedicata a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Nello specifico la risorsa si occuperà di redazione del budget annuale e forecast mensili, con analisi puntuale degli headcount e degli scostamenti, creazione di report e dashboard per il monitoraggio dei principali HR analytics (turnover, assenze, straordinari, ferie, ecc.); eseguirà inoltre registrazioni contabili e attività di supporto amministrativo-contabile connesse al costo del personale, supporto ai processi di Payroll, con focus su tematiche e quadrature legate ai costi del personale e alla loro corretta rappresentazione. title: supervisore di contact center
description: Per grande azienda industriale, ricerchiamo un Senior IT Service Desk che contribuirà alla continuità operativa degli uffici e degli stabilimenti produttivi, assicurando un supporto informatico tempestivo ed efficace agli utenti. La posizione prevede un ruolo operativo, con autonomia nella gestione delle richieste e capacità di definire le priorità in funzione dell'impatto sulle attività aziendali e sulla produzione. Le principali attività Fornire supporto IT di primo livello su PC, laptop, telefoni, periferiche, stampanti e dispositivi utilizzati negli stabilimenti, incluse le stampanti per etichette. Installare, configurare e sostituire hardware e software standard, supportando gli utenti nell'utilizzo delle applicazioni aziendali. Gestire richieste e incidenti tramite Jira, effettuando una prima diagnosi e indirizzando le problematiche ai team specialistici o ai fornitori quando necessario. Supportare onboarding e offboarding IT, predisponendo postazioni e accessi di base. Collaborare con i team IT locali e di gruppo, nel rispetto delle procedure aziendali e delle policy di sicurezza. Il profilo che cerchiamo Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Service Desk o Help Desk, indicativamente di 5-7 anni. Buona conoscenza di Windows client, Microsoft 365 e delle attività di troubleshooting hardware e software. Conoscenza di base di Active Directory, sistemi di stampa e connettività LAN e Wi-Fi. Familiarità con strumenti di ticketing, assistenza remota e principi di sicurezza informatica. Capacità di lavorare in autonomia, comunicare con utenti di diverse funzioni e gestire le priorità con un approccio pratico e orientato al servizio. Diploma tecnico o formazione equivalente in ambito informatico. Conoscenza della lingua inglese adeguata all'interazione con colleghi e team IT di gruppo. È gradita un'esperienza in contesti industriali o manifatturieri, utile a comprendere le esigenze degli ambienti produttivi e la criticità dei dispositivi a supporto della produzione. description: Gi Group, prima Agenzia per il Lavoro italiana con oltre 200 filiali sul territorio nazionale e più di 1.800 professionisti, ricerca per struttura di ospitalità contemporanea con sede a Venezia una figura di: HEAD CHEF _VENEZIA La risorsa guiderà la cucina della sede di Venezia, una location dal carattere giovane e internazionale, dove si dorme, si mangia e si vive la città. Un ambiente contemporaneo e informale che integra ospitalità e ristorazione con spazi comuni dinamici e un calendario di attività ed eventi che anima la struttura. Qui la cucina è parte centrale dell'esperienza: una proposta curata e sostenibile, pensata per viaggiatori, gruppi e city users. La figura si occuperà di: - coordinamento operativo del team e organizzazione dei turni - gestione della produzione e del servizio, garantendo qualità e standard - pianificazione e monitoraggio degli approvvigionamenti (ordini e fornitori) - supervisione di igiene e sicurezza alimentare secondo normativa HACCP - collaborazione con la direzione per l'ottimizzazione dei processi e dei costi Requisiti: - esperienza pregressa in ruoli analoghi, preferibilmente in contesti hospitality - autonomia nella gestione della cucina e del servizio Soft skills - spiccate doti di leadership e capacità di gestione del team - creatività e attenzione ai dettagli - orientamento alla qualità e problem solving Cosa offriamo: - inserimento diretto in azienda - orario: 40 ore settimanali - CCNL: FIPE Pubblici Esercizi - RAL: 34.000/40.000 - inquadramento: 2°/3° livello - benefit: mensa aziendale - sede di lavoro: Venezia (si specifica che non è previsto alloggio messo a disposizione dalla struttura) Facciamo parte di Gi Group Holding (www.gigroupholding.it ) la prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, nonché una delle principali realtà a livello mondiale nei servizi dedicati allo sviluppo del mercato del lavoro. description: Grafton LifeScience - Valorizziamo il tuo potenziale nel mondo LifeScience Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, dedicati a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito R&D, Clinical Research, Regulatory, Quality e Operation per il settore Farmaceutico e Medicale. Lavoriamo per accompagnare ogni persona verso le mansioni e i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le sue competenze e aspettative. Per il Gruppo Sterling, sede di Malta, ricerchiamo un/una QP & QA Manager con solida esperienza in ambito GMP, a supporto del mantenimento e del miglioramento continuo del Sistema Qualità aziendale. Costituisce requisito essenziale il possesso dei requisiti di QP eligibility secondo la normativa vigente applicabile (EU/Malta). Perché Sterling e perché Malta? - Internazionalità che arricchisce: un team di 8 nazionalità diverse, dove ogni giorno si impara a leggere situazioni nuove e a crescere anche sul piano personale. - Crescita reale e visibilità: il talento viene riconosciuto, la fiducia è concreta. Chi dimostra determinazione costruisce un percorso rapido e solido. - Formazione continua: programmi pensati per sviluppare competenze tecniche e soft skills, con HR e management sempre presenti. - Esperienza internazionale e qualità della vita: Malta è vicina a casa ma immersa in un contesto globale. Lavorare qui significa investire su se stessi, in un ambiente dinamico che stimola apertura mentale e capacità di adattamento. La risorsa opererà in stretta collaborazione con l'Head of Quality Unit e sarà responsabile dei rilasci delle seguenti attività: Gestione, aggiornamento e applicazione del Sistema di Qualità GMP, inclusa la documentazione (SOP, Master Documents, specifiche, metodi analitici) Coordinamento dei processi di Change Control, Deviation, CAPA e Quality Risk Management Supervisione delle attività di validazione (processi, cleaning, metodi analitici), qualifica e calibrazione di impianti e apparecchiature Gestione degli studi di stabilità e delle attività affidate a fornitori e laboratori esterni Conduzione e gestione di audit interni ed esterni (autorità, clienti, terze parti) Supervisione degli aspetti regolatori e dei sistemi elettronici GMP (inclusa audit trail review) Gestione di reclami, resi e richiami, qualifica fornitori e Quality Agreement Supporto alle attività propedeutiche al Batch Release Pianificazione ed erogazione della formazione GMP del personale Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in discipline scientifiche coerenti con i requisiti QP (es. Farmacia/CTF/Chimica/Biologia) Esperienza come Quality Assurance Manager in ambito GMP (farmaceutico/biotech/CDMO) Ottima conoscenza normativa e buona conoscenza della lingua inglese Leadership, empatia, comunicazione efficace Spirito di iniziativa e adattamento a contesti multiculturali Disponibilità relocation a Malta (o domicilio/residenza sul territorio) Cosa offriamo: Contratto di assunzione diretta a tempo indeterminato. description: On behalf of the Italian Entrepreneurial Holding of a growing international Group, we are looking for a Consolidation & Reporting Manager. Reporting directly to the Corporate Finance Manager, this is a stand-alone role. Key Responsibilities Preparation of monthly and annual consolidated financial statements, including adjusting and consolidation entries. Reconciliation of intercompany accounts and elimination entries, including the investigation and resolution of reconciliation variances. Management of changes in the consolidation scope, including acquisitions, mergers, takeovers, and corporate reorganizations. Support in accounting for Purchase Price Allocation (PPA), goodwill, and consolidation differences, where applicable. Preparation of reporting packages and accounting instructions for Group companies. Analysis of data submitted by subsidiaries, ensuring completeness, accuracy, and consistency, and managing detailed follow-up requests. Support in preparing the consolidated Notes to the Financial Statements and documentation for auditors and corporate governance bodies. Liaison with the Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A) team to ensure consistency between management reporting and consolidated financial data. Liaison with the administrative teams of foreign subsidiaries, providing support for accounting and administrative activities. Requirements Degree in Economics, Accounting, Finance, or a related field. 5+ years of experience in Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting, External Audit, or Corporate Accounting. Previous experience within multinational listed companies or top-tier audit and advisory firms. Strong knowledge of IAS/IFRS Proven ability to manage complex reporting activities under tight deadlines Fluent English, both written and spoken, used regularly in a professional environment. title: Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d) (Industrie-, Produktdesigner/in)
description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Industrial Design Engineer

Stellenbeschreibung:
Gelebte Werte haben für Sie eine Bedeutung?

Lebens-Qualität am Arbeitsplatz ist Ihnen wichtig?

HOPPE, europaweit Marktführer in der Entwicklung, Herstellung und Vermarktung von Beschlagsystemen für Türen und Fenster, ist mit rund 2.200 Mitarbeitern international tätig. In dem eigentümergeführten Familien-Unternehmen ist die wertebasierte und sinnorientierte Unternehmensführung die Basis unseres täglichen Arbeitens.

Wir machen Wohnkultur im Detail. Seit Jahrzehnten schaffen wir hochwertige Beschlaglösungen für Fenster und Türen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden.

Jetzt gehen wir den nächsten Schritt: Wir vergrößern unser Team in der Entwicklung / Konstruktion und suchen dafür zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen:

Industrial Design Engineer (m/w/d)

Bei uns gestalten Sie die Designsprache zukünftiger HOPPE-Produkte aktiv mit und begleiten neue Produktideen von der ersten Handskizze bis zur Serienreife.

Zu Ihren Hauptaufgaben gehören:

- Begleitung von Designprojekten als Grundlage für die nachfolgende Konstruktion
- Erarbeitung innovativer Designkonzepte mittels Handskizzen, digitaler Zeichnungen und 3D-Formstudien
- Weiterentwicklung einer konsistenten Designsprache über verschiedene Produktlinien hinweg
- Erstellung fotorealistischer Renderings und Visualisierungen für Produktpräsentationen, Marketingmaßnahmen und Kundenprojekte
- Aufbereitung von Designvarianten für interne Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie Kundenpräsentationen
- Begleitung von Designprojekten von der ersten Idee über die Konzeptentwicklung bis zur Markteinführung
- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktmanagement, Vermarktung, Werbung sowie Konstruktion und Vorentwicklung
- Frühzeitige Abstimmung zur technischen und fertigungstechnischen Umsetzbarkeit neuer Produktideen
- Mitwirkung bei Design-Reviews sowie Bewertung von Prototypen und Vorserienteilen hinsichtlich Designqualität und Anmutung
- Aktive Rolle im produktbezogenen Freigabeprozess für gestalterische Fragestellungen
- Branchenübergreifende Beobachtung von Designtrends und Adaptierung auf HOPPE
- Aktive Mitarbeit in Produktentwicklungs-Projekten

Wir freuen uns auf ein Gespräch mit Ihnen, wenn Sie – mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung und aufbauend auf einem Studium im Bereich Industrial Design oder Produktdesign – folgendes mitbringen:

Wissen

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Industrial Design, Produktdesign oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
- Kenntnisse moderner Design- und Visualisierungsmethoden
- Verständnis von Werkstoffen, Oberflächen und Fertigungsprozessen
- Grundlegendes technisches Verständnis für die Zusammenarbeit mit Produktentwicklung und Fertigungstechnologie

Wollen

- Ausgeprägtes gestalterisches Gespür gepaart mit technischem Verständnis
- Hohe Kommunikations- und Moderationsfähigkeit zur Vermittlung zwischen gestalterischen und technischen Anforderungen
- Leidenschaft für Gestaltung und Produktentwicklung
- Eigenständige, strukturierte und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
- Freude an interdisziplinärer Zusammenarbeit
- Bereitschaft zu standortübergreifender Zusammenarbeit und gelegentlichen Dienstreisen

Können

- Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Industrial Design, vorzugsweise im Bereich Beschläge
- Sicherer Umgang mit Design-, Rendering- und Visualisierungssoftware (z. B. SolidWorks, KeyShot, oder vergleichbare Anwendungen)
- Erfahrung in der 3D-Formgestaltung und Entwicklung von Designstudien
- Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Präsentationsfähigkeiten
- Fähigkeit, gestalterische und technische Anforderungen erfolgreich miteinander zu verbinden
- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und fließende Englischkenntnisse

Das erwartet Sie bei HOPPE:

- Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
- Die Möglichkeit, die zukünftige Designsprache unserer Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten
- Mitarbeit an internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten
- Arbeiten in einem wirtschaftlich stabilen, werteorientierten Familienunternehmen mit echter Wertschätzung
- Offene Kommunikation und ein partnerschaftliches Miteinander
- Langfristige Perspektiven und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Die Stelle ist grundsätzlich an einem unserer Standorte in Deutschland (Stadtallendorf, Bromskirchen, Crottendorf) oder auch an unserem Standort in Italien (Schluderns) zu besetzen.

Bitte senden Sie Ihre vollständige Bewerbung unter Angabe Ihres frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und Ihrer Einkommensvorstellung an lena.dreyer@hoppe.com (https://mailto:lena.dreyer@hoppe.com)

title: 3D Production Manager (m/f/d) (3-D-Artist)
description:
We`re fast. We‘re colorful. We are loud and quiet. We love what we do and make an important contribution to our customers‘ success every day. We create quality and are one of the leading media and IT service providers in Europe. From Germany and our locations in Asia, we advise and support international clients in several sectors such as advertising, photography, trade and industry. SCHNELLMEDIA stands for know-how and future. Our passion is professional image editing, online and print production as well as real 3D/AI visualization.

We are SCHNELLMEDIA and have a lot of plans.

A strong team needs strong personalities, therefore we are looking for a

3D Production Manager (m/f/d)
Hanoi, Vietnam, Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm
YOUR TASKS:

- Leadership of a motivated 3D production team (Home & Living, Fashion, Retail Industry)
- Oversee daily 3D asset production operations, ensuring smooth delivery and efficient workflows
- Building, developing and motivating the team in Hanoi
- Monitoring, ensuring, and optimizing processes
- Organizing and coordinating between the local branch and the German headquarters
- Actively contributing to the further development of our company
YOUR PROFILE:

- Experience in leadership
- Experience in 3D software such as Blender and/or 3DsMax, Vray for good understanding of 3D workflows
- Experience in photorealistic 3D visualizations of products (focus on furniture) is a plus
- Enjoy working with people and communicating in a solution-oriented manner
- High social and communication skills, flexibility and reliability
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong sense of responsibility and assertiveness
- Fluent English (business level)
OUR TOP 3 REASONS:

- Corporate culture characterized by cooperation and co-design
- Responsibility right from the start
- Short decision-making processes in a growing and international company

After an intensive induction phase, we will of course support you with your relocation to Hanoi and be on hand to answer any questions you may have. Apply now with your complete application documents, your earliest possible starting date and your salary expectations.
WE LOOK FORWARD TO RECEIVING YOUR APPLICATION.

-------------------

Wir sind schnell. Wir sind farbenfroh. Wir sind laut und leise. Wir lieben, was wir tun, und leisten täglich einen wichtigen Beitrag zum Erfolg unserer Kunden. Wir schaffen Qualität und zählen zu den führenden Medien- und IT-Dienstleistern in Europa. Von Deutschland und unseren Standorten in Asien aus beraten und unterstützen wir internationale Kunden aus verschiedensten Branchen – etwa Werbung, Fotografie, Handel und Industrie. SCHNELLMEDIA steht für Know-how und Zukunft. Unsere Leidenschaft gilt der professionellen Bildbearbeitung, der Online- und Printproduktion sowie der echten 3D- und KI-Visualisierung.

Wir sind SCHNELLMEDIA und haben viel vor. Ein starkes Team braucht starke Persönlichkeiten – daher suchen wir einen

3D Production Manager (m/w/d)
Hanoi (Vietnam) sowie Hamburg, Berlin, Amsterdam, Paris, Madrid, Lissabon, Mailand, London, Stockholm

DEINE AUFGABEN:

Führung eines motivierten 3D-Produktionsteams (Bereiche: Home & Living, Fashion, Einzelhandel)
Steuerung der täglichen 3D-Asset-Produktion sowie Sicherstellung reibungsloser Abläufe und effizienter Workflows
Aufbau, Weiterentwicklung und Motivation des Teams in Hanoi
Überwachung, Sicherstellung und Optimierung von Prozessen
Organisation und Koordination der Zusammenarbeit zwischen dem Standort vor Ort und der deutschen Zentrale
Aktive Mitgestaltung der Weiterentwicklung unseres Unternehmens

DEIN PROFIL:

Führungserfahrung
Erfahrung mit 3D-Software wie Blender und/oder 3ds Max sowie V-Ray für ein fundiertes Verständnis von 3D-Workflows
Erfahrung in der fotorealistischen 3D-Produktvisualisierung (Schwerpunkt Möbel) ist von Vorteil
Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen und lösungsorientierter Kommunikation
Hohe soziale Kompetenz und Kommunikationsstärke, Flexibilität sowie Zuverlässigkeit
Strukturierte, eigenständige und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise
Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Durchsetzungsstärke
Fließende Englischkenntnisse (verhandlungssicher)

UNSERE TOP-3-GRÜNDE:

Eine von Zusammenarbeit und Mitgestaltung geprägte Unternehmenskultur
Verantwortung von Anfang an
Kurze Entscheidungswege in einem wachsenden, internationalen Unternehmen
Nach einer intensiven Einarbeitungsphase unterstützen wir dich selbstverständlich bei deinem Umzug nach Hanoi und stehen dir bei Fragen jederzeit zur Seite. Bewirb dich jetzt mit deinen vollständigen Unterlagen unter Angabe deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins und deiner Gehaltsvorstellung.

WIR FREUEN UNS AUF DEINE BEWERBUNG.

Ergänzende Informationen:
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Visualisierungs- und Animationssoftware Blender, Grafikprogramm 3D Studio Max/3ds Max, 3-D-Design, Grafik-Design (Gebrauchsgrafik)

title: Database and network professionals
description: Per conto di una realtà tecnologica di grandi dimensioni, operante in un contesto internazionale, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Senior Cyber Security Engineer da inserire all'interno di un team Cyber Security strutturato. La risorsa entrerà a far parte di una funzione tecnica che opera trasversalmente a supporto delle diverse aree IT, Software e Business del Gruppo, contribuendo alla progettazione, evoluzione e miglioramento dei servizi e dei controlli di Cyber Security. Cerchiamo un professionista con una buona seniority tecnica e una visione trasversale della sicurezza, capace di andare oltre la gestione operativa degli incidenti e contribuire all'evoluzione dell'ecosistema Cyber aziendale. Principali responsabilità La persona sarà coinvolta in attività quali: supporto a nuovi progetti IT e Software secondo principi di Security by Design, attraverso security review e definizione dei requisiti di sicurezza; definizione ed evoluzione dei controlli di Cloud Security, principalmente in ambienti Microsoft Azure e AWS; presidio delle tematiche di Identity Security, con particolare riferimento a Microsoft Entra ID e Active Directory; valutazione e scouting di nuove tecnologie e servizi messi a disposizione dai principali cloud e security provider; evoluzione dei servizi di Cyber Security Monitoring, collaborando con il SOC esterno e contribuendo al tuning delle piattaforme SIEM e dei relativi controlli di detection; attività di Vulnerability Management su componenti infrastrutturali e applicative; evoluzione dei presidi di sicurezza relativi a Firewall, WAF, endpoint, infrastrutture e ambienti Cloud; supporto ad attività di Incident Response e miglioramento continuo dei relativi processi e controlli; partecipazione alla definizione di iniziative di Purple Teaming, finalizzate all'identificazione delle aree di miglioramento della postura difensiva; confronto con Software Architect, Service Manager, team IT e Business per integrare i requisiti Cyber all'interno di nuovi servizi e applicazioni; supporto, quando necessario, nel confronto con clienti enterprise sui presidi di sicurezza adottati nei servizi erogati. Profilo ricercato Cerchiamo un professionista con esperienza in ambito Cyber Security Engineering, Cloud Security, Infrastructure Security o Security Architecture, maturata in contesti aziendali strutturati o all'interno di società di consulenza tecnologica. Non è necessario aver maturato esperienza approfondita in tutte le aree indicate. Sarà particolarmente interessante una solida competenza in una o più delle seguenti: Cloud Security in ambienti Azure e/o AWS; Identity & Access Security, Entra ID / Active Directory; Security Engineering e definizione di security controls; Cyber Security Monitoring e tecnologie SIEM/XDR; Vulnerability Management; Infrastructure & Network Security; Application Security / Security by Design. Saranno considerate un plus esperienze in ambito Microsoft Security, Microsoft 365 Security, Incident Response, Purple Teaming e attività di security assessment. È richiesta una buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Offerta RAL indicativa: €50.000 - €60.000 + MBO, valutabile in funzione dell'esperienza; inserimento diretto a tempo indeterminato; modalità di lavoro ibrida con 2 giorni alla settimana in presenza a Bologna; #LI-AM2

title: COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2) (Kapitän/in)
description:
The MV Louise Michel is a former French Navy boat we’ve customized to perform search and rescue. Measuring 30 meters in length and capable of up to 28 knots, she was bought with proceeds from the sale of Banksy artwork - who then decorated her with a fire extinguisher. She is operated and crewed by a team of international activist rescue professionals.

- Main responsibilities: handling the ship, overview, control of the vessel and crew safety
- You have the final responsibility for all nautical and technical decisions concerning the operation as well as related crew intructions
- responsible for the ship’s administration (bunkering, crew-lists, customs clearance, detailed operational documentation, daily reports and statistics).
- shiphandling in harbour and during SAR-operations. Together with the officers you will familiarise the crew on the bridge and introduce them to the watch system.
- You will provide the crew with trainings and drills in emergency situations (e.g. what to do in case of fire, POB, ingress of water, unwanted visitors).
- You will work closely with the Head of operations during SAR operations, double checking all decisions against crew and ship safety as well as stability (and guest safety in case of guest already on board).
- You will work closely with the officers and chief engineer

Required:

-EC/EEA-Citizen Passport valid for at least 6 months

-Covid certificate with EU QR code needed, latest vaccine or recovery certificate no older than 180 days or a booster (other nationalities can be transferred to EU certificate)

-Seafarer Medical Certificate (fitness for sea service) according STCW I/9 (Deck Service)

-Proficiency in basic safety (STCW VI/1)

-Proficiency in survival craft and rescue boats other than fast rescue boats (STCW VI/2-1)

-Proficiency in Advanced fire fighting (STCW VI/3)

-Medical First Aid (STCW VI/4-1)

-Medical Care (STCW VI/4-2)

-GMDSS Radio Operator GOC (STCW IV/2)

-COC Master 500GT-3000GT or more than 3000GT (STCW II/2)

-German Endorsement for COC Master Course

-Seafarer's book or the German Seafarer's ID Card

-Excellent and fluent English language skills

-Confidence in decision-making, strong team leading skills, and the ability to cooperate well within a team of volunteers with various levels of nautical experience and skill.

Desired:

- Previous SAR experience
- Italian, French and Arabic language skills

title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.


Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt.

Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

title: Kiemsargis
description:
1.    Palaikyti švarą ir tvarką mokyklos teritorijoje.
2.    Kasdien nušluoti takelius, šaligatvius, iškaupti žolę takeliuose ir žaidimų aikštelėse, surinkti šiukšles (1–2 val. prieš ateinant vaikams).
3.    Vasaros, rudens ir pavasario laikotarpiu prižiūrėti bei laistyti gėlynus, pjauti žolę.
4.    Prižiūrėti ir tinkamai eksploatuoti naudojamą techniką: žoliapjovę, žoliapjovės traktorių, trimerius (valyti, tikrinti techninę būklę, atlikti smulkų remontą, laiku informuoti apie gedimus).
5.    Užtikrinti tinkamą technikos saugojimą, laikymą ir priežiūrą ne darbo metu.
6.    Vykdyti kuro sunaudojimo apskaitą, racionaliai naudoti kurą ir kitas eksploatacines medžiagas.
7.    Žiemą nukasti sniegą nuo takelių, šaligatvių, žaidimų aikštelių, įėjimų į pastatą, barstyti takelius smėliu.
8.    Kasdien apžiūrėti inventorių; esant gedimams – remontuoti savo jėgomis arba informuoti pavaduotoją ūkio reikalams.
9.    Perdažyti lauko įrenginius, atlikti smulkų jų remontą.
Kiemsargio atsakomybė: už mokyklos teritorijos priežiūrą ir tvarką; už sanitarinių higieninių reikalavimų vykdymą; už saugos darbe ir priešgaisrinės saugos reikalavimų laikymąsi; Už patikėtos technikos, įrankių ir inventoriaus saugumą, tinkamą naudojimą bei priežiūrą; už kuro ir eksploatacinių medžiagų racionalų naudojimą; už aukščiau išvardintų pareigų vykdymą.
Kiemsargis privalo: vykdyti mokyklos direktoriaus, pavaduotojo ūkiui arba įgaliotų asmenų su darbu susijusius nurodymus. Mokėti saugiai dirbti ir netrukdyti saugiai dirbti kitiems. Laiku tikrintis sveikatą. Laikytis įstaigos vidaus tvarkos taisyklių, darbe nevartoti alkoholinių gėrimų bei narkotinių medžiagų. Laikytis įrenginių naudojimo instrukcijų reikalavimų, asmens higienos reikalavimų.

Pasiūlymų teikimas su aiškiu galiojimo terminu.

Eksporto ir atliekų vežimo dokumentai: Annex VII per DIWASS, GPAIS lydraščiai, sąskaitos,
svėrimo pažymos, CMR, eksporto deklaracijos.
Konteinerių užsakymas ir pakrovimo koordinavimas su aikštele bei ekspedicija.
Svorio ir kokybės pretenzijų po iškrovimo sprendimas.
Apmokėjimo sekimas iki pinigų gavimo.

title: Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (m/f)
description:
Senior Relationship Manager - AIF Depositary (M/F)
Luxembourg
req1167

Apply Now

BIL is a leading player in Luxembourg's financial market. Founded in 1856 as the country's first bank, BIL has contributed significantly to the development of Luxembourg's social and economic landscape. Today, BIL operates across digital banking, wealth management and corporate finance, supporting individuals, entrepreneurs, businesses, and both private and institutional investors. Headquartered in Luxembourg, BIL employs more than 1,800 people and maintains a presence in key financial centers including Luxembourg, Switzerland, France and China. As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your Key Objectives:

You will be responsible for implementing the Bank's commercial strategy and risk policy within the Alternative Funds segment, both in Luxembourg and abroad. You will manage and develop profitable client relationships, promote the Institutional Banking Value Proposition, and contribute to the growth of the Alternative Investment Funds business.

Your next challenge:

• Manage and develop a portfolio of clients in the Custodian Banking/Depositary segment and foster long-term relationships through regular client interactions.
• Act as the primary point of contact for clients within BIL, ensuring effective coordination between clients and all relevant internal stakeholders.
• Achieve assigned objectives in terms of revenue, costs, deposit collection and credit production, while actively contributing to the performance of the Alternative Investment Funds (AIF) team and Institutional Banking (IB).
• Promote the IB Value Proposition by developing a thorough understanding of clients' situations and proposing solutions that address their current and future needs.
• Maintain a strong knowledge of BIL's products and services, particularly those dedicated to AIF clients.
• Leverage the expertise available across IB to deliver comprehensive client solutions, drive cross-selling initiatives and identify business growth opportunities in collaboration with the Business Developers.
• Ensure compliance with all applicable policies, procedures and regulatory requirements, including KYC and AML obligations.
• Oversee the operational follow-up of client requests and instructions, working closely with the Business Office and Compliance teams to ensure service quality and efficiency.
• Contribute to knowledge sharing and training initiatives within Institutional Banking by supporting colleagues and continuously developing specialized expertise.
• Act as an ambassador of the BIL Group through participation in conferences, presentations, training sessions and industry events, while maintaining a strong professional network.
• Contribute to the development and enhancement of products and services for AIF clients through an innovative and client-focused approach.

Your skills:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Administration, Audit, Law, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
• Minimum 5 to 7 years of experience in the banking, fund industry and/or depositary environment.
• Excellent understanding of the AIFMD framework and the related legal and regulatory environment.
• In-depth knowledge of alternative asset classes, including Private Equity, Private Debt, Real Estate and Infrastructure.
• Extensive understanding of banking activities, organisational structures, operational risk management processes and control frameworks.
• Solid knowledge of banking products and services, including cash and treasury management, securities services, financing and capital markets solutions.
• Proven experience in operational risk assessment, process enhancement and monitoring activities.
• Good understanding of the key drivers and market dynamics of the European fund industry.
• Strong analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills, both written and verbal.
• Team player with an entrepreneurial mindset and a collaborative approach.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of additional languages is considered an asset.
• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications.

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths .We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled. Other documents will be collected, to the extent legally permitted, to perform background checks.

Vous interviendrez sur l'ensemble du cycle de vie des solutions : analyse des besoins, conception, installation, configuration, mise en production, maintenance, support et amélioration continue.

• Assurer l'installation, la configuration et le support des solutions de notification serveur Mobicall et d'appel malade ;
• Participer à l'intégration des solutions d'appel malade avec les environnements téléphoniques et les systèmes clients ;
• Évoluer vers une expertise complète des solutions de notification serveur, d'appel malade et de communication destinées aux établissements de soins ;
• Assurer la maintenance préventive et corrective des infrastructures installées ;
• Participer aux migrations, montées de version et évolutions techniques des plateformes ;
• Assurer la permanence technique selon un système de roulement ;
• Prendre en charge le suivi administratif et technique des projets ;
• Mettre à jour la base de données et la documentation des clients ;
• Rédiger les rapports d'intervention, dossiers techniques, procédures et documents d'exploitation ;
• Produire et maintenir les documentations de configuration et les dossiers « as-built » ;
• Assurer une communication technique claire et professionnelle avec les clients ;
• Collaborer avec les fournisseurs, les équipes internes et les autres intervenants des projets ;
• Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des méthodes, procédures et outils internes ;
• Développer régulièrement vos compétences techniques ;

title: Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract (m/f)
description:
Lower School Teaching Assistant (Gr2 Classrooms) 6-months contract

We're delighted that you're considering joining our learning community at ISL. As you consider this opportunity, we kindly ask that you apply only if you can join us on the stated start date and will be fully free from any existing contractual or notice-period obligations by that time. We appreciate your understanding.

The role?
At ISL, we believe our young learners are capable, curious and full of ideas. They learn through relationships, play, inquiry and meaningful exploration of the world around them. We are seeking a Lower School Classroom Teaching Assistant to assist our Grade 2 teachers (students ages 7-8) in creating caring, inclusive environments where every student feels a sense of belonging, develops agency and independence, and experiences the joy of learning.

Working in partnership with the classroom teacher and wider Lower School team, the Teaching Assistant is an important resource for students and parents.

What will you do?

Working alongside the Grade 2 classroom teachers, you will:

• help create a caring and inquiry-rich learning environment;
• support individuals and small groups during student-initiated and teacher-directed learning;
• encourage curiosity, communication, collaboration, creativity and problem-solving;
• observe and document students' learning and emerging needs;
• prepare materials and learning spaces that invite exploration;
• support arrival, dismissal, transitions, specialist lessons, lunch, playground and other daily routines;
• help children develop positive relationships, independence and a sense of responsibility; and
• supervise and accompany students during activities, field trips and other experiences beyond the classroom.

What skills do you bring?

We are interested in what you can do, how you work with others and your potential to learn and grow. Your skills may have been developed through education, employment, volunteering, or community activities.

You will be able to demonstrate your ability to:

• Build trusting relationships with young students, helping them feel safe, known and valued.
• Support learning through inquiry, using conversation, thoughtful questions and exploration to extend students' thinking.
• Notice and respond to learners, observing students and collaborating with the teachers to document learning and development.
• Foster agency and independence, knowing when to support, when to question and when to give students space to try for themselves.
• Support multilingual learners and communicate clearly and sensitively with students developing English as an additional language.
• Create inclusive environments that value different languages, cultures, experiences and ways of learning.
• Collaborate effectively with teachers and colleagues and build positive, professional relationships with
• families.
• Support students' wellbeing, relationships, routines, transitions and self-management in developmentally appropriate ways.
• Adapt and take initiative in the dynamic environment of a classroom.
• Reflect and grow, welcoming feedback and taking responsibility for your own professional learning.

Who you are?

You genuinely enjoy being with young students and see them as capable learners. You are patient, curious, dependable and proactive. You understand that learning happens throughout the day—from a student's question to developing independence during routines or navigating a disagreement with a friend. You communicate thoughtfully, value different perspectives and cultures, and know that excellent support sometimes means stepping forward and sometimes stepping back.
Above all, you bring care, curiosity, collaboration and a commitment to helping every student participate, learn and belong.
Our commitment to students
Through this role, you will support ISL's Strategic Plan by helping deliver a Lower School programme that meets high creative and academic standards and enables students to be active, engaged and successful learners.
ISL is committed to safeguarding and prioritising the wellbeing of children and young people and expects you to share this commitment. You will be expected to maintain appropriate professional boundaries, demonstrate sound judgement and follow ISL's child protection, health, safety and security policies and procedures.
We are keen to attract applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly those whose nationality, identity, gender or race is currently under-represented in international education.
Profile: (training, experience, skills and aptitudes necessary to do the job)

Required:

• A minimum of a secondary school diploma or equivalent.
• Fluency in English, with strong spoken and written communication.
• Successful experience working with children, ideally ages 7-8;
• Strong interpersonal, communication and collaboration skills;
• Confidence with digital technology relevant to the role.
• The ability to work positively and responsibly with children and adults.

Valued experience includes:

We value experience working with young students in educational settings, childcare, after-school programmes or other environments where children learn and develop together. Particularly relevant experience includes supporting play- or inquiry-based learning, multilingual learners, children's social-emotional development and
independence, and working collaboratively with colleagues and families in culturally diverse communities. Experience in an IB PYP or another child-centred, inquiry-based setting is an advantage, but is not essential.
We recognise that strong candidates bring different experiences and pathways. We encourage you to apply if you believe your skills, approach and experience equip you to succeed in this role, even if you do not meet every preferred criterion.

Among main responsibilities:

General:

• Assist in creating a caring, positive learning environment as directed by the classroom teacher;
• Promote mutual respect and understanding among all members of the group;
• Establish and maintain positive relationships with students, parents, colleagues and leadership;
• Assist in maintaining expectations of student behaviour in and out of the classroom to create a well-functioning and consistent learning atmosphere in school;
• Comply with School policies and procedures relating to child protection, health, safety, welfare, security, confidentiality and data protection, reporting any concerns to the appropriate person;
• Collaborate with the classroom teacher to gather and document evidence of student learning;
• Maintain familiarity and understanding of the ISL curriculum and assist in its delivery as directed by the classroom teacher and appropriate for level of qualification;
• Support the Lower School culture of thinking;
• Be familiar with all school rules and conscientiously assist in enforcing them;
Within the Classroom:
• Assist with classroom related tasks (including preparation, set-up and clearing up of materials for learning activities and supervision thereof) as directed by the classroom teacher;
• Assist the teacher at the start and end of the day welcoming and dismissing students (including taking attendance and lunch count as well as supervising students during transitions);

Outside of the Classroom:

• Perform supervisory duties within other areas of the school (cafeteria, playgrounds, etc) as directed;
• Assist a student in the event of sickness or accident;
• Accompany the classroom teacher and students on field trips and other excursions outside school;
