title: Legal Counsel
description:
If you are a commercially minded lawyer who wants to take ownership of complex, business-critical matters, work close to senior decision-makers as well as make an impact in a broad range of legal, strategic and business initiatives across an internationally listed company, take this unique opportunity to become our new

Legal Counsel, Corporate Legal

We are now looking for an experienced Legal Counsel to join Corporate Legal at SKF's global headquarters in Gothenburg. You will take a leading legal role in selected matters, with direct exposure to senior stakeholders and responsibility for delivering practical solutions on some of SKF's most strategic and business-critical initiatives.

What we and the role offers:

Corporate Legal is part of SKF's lean corporate center and the wider Group Legal & Compliance function. We are a small, strong and business-centric team supporting SKF's leadership and key stakeholders in the central group functions. Our mandate covers matters of strategic importance, significant legal or commercial risk and a broad range of operational legal questions. Working at the intersection of law, business, technology and corporate governance, you will gain direct insight into key decisions and the opportunity to influence how complex matters are structured and executed across a large international corporation. The role has a distinctly global reach, offering frequent opportunities to work alongside legal colleagues, business leaders and specialists across SKF's worldwide organisation.

Our work spans many of the legal areas that support SKF's business and long-term development, including strategic projects and collaborations, M&A, governance, commercial contracting, IT, innovation and technology development, litigation and claims management, corporate finance, marketing and media.



What you can expect in the role:

    Independently manage your matters from initial assessment through drafting, negotiation, decision and implementation, while knowing when to involve colleagues or external counsel
    Form a clear legal view, recommend a course of action and help stakeholders move from analysis to decision and implementation
    Advise senior stakeholders across Finance, Treasury, Investor Relations, Sustainability, IT, Supply Chain, Communications, People Experience (HR) and other group functions.
    Draft, negotiate and review a wide range of agreements
    Support M&A, strategic projects, governance, commercial contracts, technology and innovation initiatives
    Manage litigation and claims-related matters
    Provide pragmatic, business-focused legal advice and risk management support
    Collaborate with legal colleagues and business leaders across SKF's global organization, giving you the opportunity to build an international network and contribute across jurisdictions while helping stakeholders meet business objectives and manage legal risk.



What makes this role particularly unique is the combination of autonomy and breadth of the Corporate Legal mandate. Few in-house legal positions at large international companies offer exposure to such a wide range of matters together with genuine responsibility for shaping solutions. You can remain a broad corporate lawyer while building a recognized area of expertise in the fields that genuinely interest you and that align with our business. We think lawyers perform at their best when they pair a wide view of the business with deeper knowledge in the areas that interest them most. As a result, the exact shape of the role will develop over time depending on your experience, interests and strengths, as well as the needs of the business.

We expect you to have/be:

    Master's degree in law (LLM).
    Extensive relevant experience from a well-renowned law firm, an international company or a combination of both.
    Comfortable in leading discussions and challenging constructively and making progress when the path is not yet fully defined.
    Establish credibility with senior stakeholders through effective communication, integrity, engagement and turn legal analysis into practical options.
    Analytically skilled with the ability to approach complex issues with commercial curiosity, integrity and a can-do attitude.
    Experience in commercial contracts or transactions is valuable.
    Enjoy variety and are comfortable switching between high-level strategic discussions and detailed legal analysis.
    Eager to continue to learn and develop across an evolving legal landscape.
    Collaborative and confident working across cultures and functions
    Proficiency in both verbal communication and presentations in English. Swedish is desirable, and so is other languages.

What you'll love about SKF...

*A culture of diversity and inclusion!

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF

*Fair and transparent compensation!

We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislation and base our decisions on objective criteria to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process.



Some additional information

title: Electronic Hardware Design Engineer
description:
Company description:

AVL is one of the world’s leading mobility technology companies for development, simulation and testing in the automotive industry, and beyond. The company provides concepts, solutions and methodologies in fields like vehicle development and integration, e-mobility, automated and connected mobility (ADAS/AD), and software for a greener, safer, better world of mobility.

Job description:

As an Electronic Hardware Design Engineer, you will play a key role in developing innovative solutions within the rapidly evolving field of automotive electronics. We are looking for a driven individual who is motivated to continuously broaden their expertise in electronic hardware, contributing both at customer sites and to the development of our in-house capabilities. The position is part of our Hardware and Systems Development team, based in Gothenburg, Sweden.

AVL takes part in a wide range of projects within Vehicle, Hybrid and Electromobility in the automotive industry. AVL MTC has approximately 200 employees based in Gothenburg, Stockholm, Haninge and Södertälje. As an engineer at AVL you will work with cutting edge technology in collaboration with experts in the global AVL team and our successful customers. You will be working close to our local customers in Gothenburg area within the AVL facilities or as Resident Engineer at customers in Sweden.


    As an Electronics Hardware Design Engineer, you will be responsible for specification, development, commissioning and validation of power inverter HW system and its subsystems (e.g. control board, power supply, gate driver board and power modules)
    Define and develop requirements, design as well as Architectures for new and existing Hardware concepts in the area of Power inverter controls, DC-DC converter controls, Zone Controller, Body controller, Battery management system and Driver assistance systems
    Create product specific and complex controls electronics while balancing constraints in space, EMI/EMC, cost and manufacturability
    Responsible for definition of detailed verification tests for the newly developed electronics. Support the actual testing and troubleshooting effort to ensure success of the newly developed designs
    Create new designs and concepts within standard automotive development process
    Good system understanding to translate requirements of hardware coming from electronics designers and software coming from the software development teams  
    Ability to work in an agile manner while operating in international teams
    Interaction and communication on technical topics with engineering teams of international customer base  

Profile description:


    Degree in Electronics/Electrical/Mechatronic engineering with relevant work experience in Electronics and Mechatronics  
    6-8 years automotive demonstrable experience in development of Embedded Hardware and Power Electronics  
    Good knowledge of handling EMC/EMI requirements, trouble shooting and engineering methods to maintain compliance
    Multiple years of experience in schematic and layout design in Altium designer and electronics simulation in LTspice.
    Knowledge of Automotive domain i.e. Design Standards and design processes  

Personal attributes:


    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English including on-site presentations at customers. Swedish is meritorious.
    Ability to adapt to customer cultures and create new opportunities to grow local expertise within the field of Electromobility.
    Self-directed, systematic, and structured approach to work.
    Teamplayer with ability to get along with a diverse set of team members
    High level of integrity and responsibility.
    B category Driving license.

We offer:


    Be part of our pioneering work– together with our customers we shape the future of mobility!
    Competitive compensation packages
    Collective Agreement and insurances
    Working with international OEMs
    International and innovative collaborations

Interested?

In this recruitment process, we apply continuous selection. The process may move quickly, and the position may be filled before the final application deadline.

title: Flexible administrative support opportunity at SSE (Hourly, up to 20%)
description:
The Education Office (EdO) is one of SSE’s Professional Services units and consists of around 58 colleagues. As a central part of the SSE journey, we support and develop key academic services for students and stakeholders across our BSc, MSc, and PhD programs. Our work spans assessment, program management, scholarships, international collaborations, academic support, central course and exam coordination, as well as degrees and certificates.

Would you like to work in a dynamic international environment and contribute to the day-to-day operations of one of Europe's leading business schools?

The Education Office at the Stockholm School of Economics (SSE) is building a small pool of flexible hourly staff who can provide support during peak periods and special projects throughout the year.

As part of our support pool, you will step in where extra resources are needed most. Assignments vary over time and may involve administrative support related to admissions, student exchange, student services, events, information services, communication, and other Education Office activities.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys variety, is highly reliable, and can quickly adapt to new tasks and teams.

Examples of assignments

You may be asked to:

    Provide administrative support during admissions periods
    Assist with exchange and international mobility activities
    Support the Info Center and student-facing services
    Help coordinate events, welcome activities, and visits
    Assist with data entry, reporting, and quality assurance
    Support communication and information updates
    Contribute to project-based administrative tasks across the Education Office

We are looking for someone who is

    Structured, accurate, and detail-oriented
    Service-minded and professional in interactions with students, faculty, staff, and visitors
    Flexible and comfortable handling different types of assignments
    Reliable and able to work independently
    Comfortable working in digital systems and administrative processes
    Fluent in English, both spoken and written
    Able to communicate in Swedish, as some assignments require interaction with Swedish-speaking stakeholders and documentation
    Comfortable handling information with discretion and confidentiality

We offer

    A flexible hourly position with varied assignments
    Experience from multiple areas of higher education administration
    The opportunity to work with colleagues across the Education Office
    A welcoming and international work environment
    Flexible scheduling based on operational needs and your availability

Hours: Approximately 4-8 hours per week (up to 20%)

Location: Stockholm School of Economics, Stockholm

Hourly salary: SEK 165/hour

Start date: As soon as possible

About the Stockholm School of Economics

The Stockholm School of Economics is ranked as the top business school in the Nordic and Baltic countries and enjoys a strong international reputation. World-class research forms the foundation of our educational offering, which includes Bachelor, Master, PhD, MBA, and Executive Education programs. Through creativity and collaboration, the Stockholm School of Economics provides an environment where ambitious students and accomplished researchers meet to address contemporary challenges within business and economics, particularly those concerning sustainability, diversity and innovation.

Apart from delivering world class education within business and economics, SSE students are trained to be successful decision makers and leaders of the future. Our educational mission has over the years strengthened SSE students, and you can read more about it here.

SSE is a member of the Stockholm Dual Career Network (SDCN), a collaboration between universities, research institutes and companies in the Stockholm region. Through SDCN, partners of international recruits are offered professional support in establishing their careers in Sweden, including career coaching, networking opportunities, seminars and access to a broad professional network. We recognize the importance of supporting accompanying partners in international relocations and are committed to facilitating a smooth transition for the whole family.

SSE is committed to a balanced gender distribution and values a variety of backgrounds and experiences among our employees. We therefore welcome all applicants regardless of their gender, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, disability, sexual orientation, age, or religion or other beliefs. We strive to have a fair and inclusive recruitment process.

title: Regional Security Director - North Europe
description:
Company description:

We are a global, diverse, inclusive security team unified by a common purpose and a pragmatic can-do attitude. As our people are core to our business, we aim to maintain an excellent work-life balance within the team.

Our service offering and expertise incorporate the following disciplines: Crisis Management, Fire Safety, Investigations, Information -, Product -, Physical -, People -, and Travel Security.  





Job description:





Are you a pragmatic and innovative security leader? Do you have a proven track record of successfully delivering security programs and operating in diverse and challenging environments? Are you a self-starter?  





Then join our team





As part of our regional team, you will be responsible for building and maintaining effective and trusted relationships with key internal and external stakeholders and providing innovative and business-orientated solutions to complex security challenges.

  



Stakeholders should recognize your role as the “can-do” subject matter expert, advisor, security auditor, responder, and trainer within their region.

Key Regional Responsibilities and Scope



The main areas of regional responsibility are Security Risk Management, Crisis Management, Physical Security, People Security, Product Security, Travel Security, Information Security and Investigations. These include the oversight of regional security governance and assurance activities.  



The main job tasks include, but are not limited to:





Contribute to developing and delivering the Global Security Strategy, Group Security programs, objectives, and priorities.



Support the development of security governance and manage the implementation and continuous refinement of security policies, standards, guidelines, instructions, requirements, and procedures.  



Provide expertise on regional security issues to senior regional and site management.



Develop and maintain security awareness programs, deliver related training to employees, and travel across the region to support security operations and awareness initiatives



Respond to requests and questions from across the business and line management for advice and assistance.



Conduct and support security risk assessments.  



Conduct site security audits to identify best practices and gaps. Support findings by providing suitable solutions to mitigate the risks.



Develop crisis training material and train local crisis response teams with support from the Head Office.



Provide accurate information and effective response to business travellers who are experiencing an incident or crisis.



Conduct Security investigations of counterfeit, illegal diversion and product theft cases and background investigations.



Maintain collaboration with internal and external stakeholders to gather intelligence to identify and evaluate threats, vulnerabilities, and associated risks to the Volvo Group.



Collaborate with other Volvo units globally to efficiently develop and deliver services and products with the best applicable quality, delivery time and cost within an agreed budget.



Establish and maintain regional relationships with security practitioners in other commercial sectors, intelligence networks, law enforcement and related government/intelligence agencies.



As a Volvo Regional Security Director you will:

Contribute to the overall development of strategic goals, performance metrics,     communication practices and culture.



Create and maintain effective partnerships with our internal Cybersecurity, IT Security, Group Security, Group Compliance, Group Audit, Group Legal and People and Culture management teams to ensure alignment, where applicable.



Build effective partnerships with business unit management whilst ensuring accountability and professionalism.



Build and nurture external networks of industry peers, ecosystem partners, vendors, and other relevant parties to address common trends, findings, incidents, and risks.



Be a respected Group Security Ambassador who aligns with the Volvo Groups’ values and principles





Profile description:Educational Experience and Preferred Knowledge:Law enforcement and/or intelligence background and/or previous security management background is requiredFluent English  Fluency in a Scandinavian language will be an advantage  Relevant security related University degree / postgraduate education  A CPP / PSP certification is desirable Several years of proven experience as a protective security practitioner – Protective Security means demonstrated expertise in physical -, people-, and travel security, crisis management and security risk management, including governance and assurance.   Several years at a senior level with strategic responsibilities – proven regional experience will be an advantage.    Last application date is October 25Location is Gothenburg, Sweden. As part of the recruitment process, a background check as well as alcohol and drug testing may be conducted. You will be informed if applicable.We value your data privacy and therefore do not accept applications via mail.  



We offer:

The Volvo Group, one of the global leaders in sustainable transport solutions, is looking for an experienced senior security leader with proven experience in protective security to drive a pragmatic security program and culture protecting Volvo Group’s people, information, products, and assets.

title: Associate Legal Counsel
description:
If you are a commercially minded lawyer at the start of your career who wants to take the next step in your development as an in-house legal counsel, working with a wide range of governance and business initiatives across an internationally listed company and collaborate with experienced legal colleagues and stakeholders around the world, close to senior decision-makers,  take this unique opportunity to become our new



Associate Legal Counsel, Corporate Legal



We are now looking for an Associate Legal Counsel to join Corporate Legal at SKF's global headquarters in Gothenburg. This role is designed for someone who has built a solid legal foundation, typically through a few years at a well-renowned law firm or as an in-house lawyer, and is now ready to take the next step.



What we and the role offer:

Corporate Legal is part of SKF's lean corporate center and the wider Group Legal & Compliance function. We are a small, strong and business-centric team supporting SKF's leadership and key stakeholders in the central group functions. Our mandate covers matters of strategic importance, significant legal or commercial risk and a broad range of operational legal questions. Working at the intersection of law, business, technology and corporate governance, you will gain direct insight into key decisions and the opportunity to influence how matters are structured and executed across a large international corporation. The role has a distinctly global reach, offering frequent opportunities to work alongside legal colleagues, business leaders and specialists across SKF's worldwide organisation.

Our work spans many of the legal areas that support SKF’s business and long-term development, including governance, strategic projects and collaborations, M&A, commercial contracting, IT, innovation and technology development, litigation and claims management, corporate finance, marketing and media.



What you can expect in the role:

    Take responsibility for a wide range of legal and governance matters.
    Engage directly with key business stakeholders and provide clear, practical legal advice, while drawing on the Corporate Legal team when appropriate.
    Drive governance and corporate processes, including legal entity management, corporate formalities and support board and shareholder matters.
    Draft and negotiate commercial agreements and support their implementation, mainly in the areas of technology development and innovation, licensing and procurement, including IT, services and machinery.
    Simplifying processes, creating a clearer and more consistent approach or exploring how new technology can support the legal function.



What makes this role particularly attractive is the opportunity to grow into the in-house lawyer role in an environment that combines trust and responsibility with the possibility to draw on experienced members of the Corporate Legal team. From the outset, you will be encouraged to take ownership of your matters and build direct relationships across the business, including with colleagues in different markets and functions around the world.

The role offers significant variety, but also flexibility in how your career develops over time. We think lawyers perform at their best when they pair a wide view of the business with deeper knowledge in the areas that interest them most. While the role provides exposure to a wide range of legal matters, you will progressively assume independent ownership of selected areas and be expected to become a trusted point of contact for the business. Over time, there will be opportunities to deepen your expertise in areas that match your interests, strengths and the needs of the business.



We expect you to have/be:

    Master's degree in law (LLM).
    Two to five years relevant experience from a well-renowned law firm, an international company or a combination of both.
    Comfortable taking ownership of matters, forming your own view and moving work forward while recognizing when to seek input or escalate an issue.
    Experience in corporate governance, capital markets, corporate finance, commercial contracts, including drafting and negotiation, or transactions is valuable.
    Structured way of working and solutions-oriented mindset.
    Commercially minded with sound judgement and a pragmatic approach.
    Be able to organize your own workload, manage competing priorities and willing to take initiative.
    Eager to continue to learn and develop across an evolving legal landscape.
    Good communication skills and enjoy working as part of a team.
    Collaborative and confident working across cultures and functions.
    Fluent in Swedish and English (written and spoken).



What you'll love about SKF...

*A culture of diversity and inclusion!

SKF is committed to creating a diverse environment, and we firmly believe that a diverse workforce is essential for our continued success. Therefore, we only focus on your experience, skills, and potential. Come as you are – just be yourself #weareSKF

*Fair and transparent compensation!

We provide transparent salary information in line with local legislation and base our decisions on objective criteria to ensure fairness and consistency throughout the recruitment process.

title: University Hospital Seeks Pediatric Ophthalmology Specialist
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time. This year, we proudly celebrate our 20th anniversary. Watch our anniversary film (https://vimeo.com/1114843079?share=copy) and join us on our journey!

Join a leading University Hospital in Southwestern Sweden!

Are you a pediatric ophthalmologist from the EU looking to grow your career in a modern, academic, and supportive environment?

A leading university hospital in southwestern Sweden is now recruiting specialists in pediatric ophthalmology to strengthen its highly specialized eye care department. This is an exciting opportunity to work with advanced diagnostics and nationally designated care for pediatric glaucoma and cataract, while contributing to education, clinical development, and research within one of Sweden’s foremost ophthalmology units.

About the role

You will join a large ophthalmology department with more than 250 professionals, covering outpatient care, emergency eye services, inpatient wards, and surgical units. The pediatric ophthalmology section provides comprehensive diagnostic and therapeutic care for children and collaborates closely with electrophysiology and hereditary disease units.

You will work in multidisciplinary teams that include physicians, orthoptists, nurses, optometrists, and technicians, all focused on delivering patient-centered, high-quality eye care. As part of a university hospital, you will also have the opportunity to participate in teaching, clinical research, and innovation projects.

Requirements

    EU-recognized specialist certification in ophthalmology
    Minimum five years of clinical experience in ophthalmology
    Focus and competence in pediatric ophthalmology
    Strong interest in teaching, research, and clinical development
    Good communication skills in English and willingness to learn Swedish
    Team-oriented, responsible, and committed to providing high-quality patient care
    Experience or competence in medical retina is considered an advantage

Language and relocation support

    A willingness and motivation to learn Swedish is important for your integration and clinical work.
    The relocation process begins once you reach language level B2. During this stage, you will work 50% clinically and study 50% Swedish until you achieve C1 level, which is required to apply for a Swedish specialist license (specialistbevis) to practice as a specialist doctor.
    Language training is provided free of charge once you have accepted an employment offer.
    You will receive full support throughout the licensing and relocation process, including assistance with documentation, Swedish authorization, and settling in Sweden.

What Dignus Medical offers you

    Ongoing support from a recruiter before, during, and after your employment
    Assistance with obtaining Swedish authorization and specialist approvals, if required

title: PhD student in agricultural bioeconomy systems
description:
Department of Biosystems and Technology

PhD project: Sustainable utilisation of agricultural green biomass in integrated protein and biogas systems

Subject area: Technology

Description of the doctoral project



A circular and fossil-independent bioeconomy requires renewable biomass without increasing competition for agricultural land and food production. Crop residues and intermediate crops are therefore particularly relevant resources. Research at SLU shows that these biomass resources can be substantial, but their potential and sustainable utilisation vary regionally. They can be used for biogas, while effects on soil carbon and nutrient cycling need to be considered.  

Green biomass can also be biorefined into plant protein for feed or food, after which the remaining streams are used for biogas. The same feedstock can thereby provide protein, energy and recycled nutrients.

The project aims to assess the potential and consequences of large-scale utilisation of green crop residues and intermediate crops in integrated biogas and green biorefinery systems.

The project will:

    assess sustainably available biomass from green crop residues and intermediate crops in Sweden;
    assess the potential for biogas and combined plant protein and biogas production;
    develop implementation scenarios based on feedstock availability, infrastructure, logistics and markets;
    assess effects on nutrient cycling, soil carbon, biomethane, fertilizer use, and feed and food production; and
    evaluate economic and wider socio-economic benefits, drawbacks and trade-offs.

The project combines GIS and agricultural data with mass and nutrient balances, scenario modelling, and life cycle-based, techno-economic and socio-economic methods. Data will be drawn from research, statistics, literature and national databases.

The doctoral student will join an interdisciplinary research environment at SLU Alnarp focusing on sustainable agricultural production, bioenergy, circular bioeconomy and systems analysis.

About the position

The work includes collection and processing of agricultural and process data, GIS, modelling of biomass and product flows, scenario development, and environmental and economic assessments.  

You will integrate information from crop production and biomass availability to biorefineries, biogas, and food and energy systems.  

You will analyse data, develop models and scenarios, and publish and present research results. The work will be conducted with researchers at SLU and external partners.  

The doctoral student will be part of the Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC), a national transdisciplinary centre where Linköping University, SLU and around 50 private and public organisations collaborate. The centre is supported by the Swedish Energy Agency. The PhD project follows BSRC’s research plans and contributes to long-term competence development in industry and academia.

Requirements

To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).

Specific entry requirements for the third-cycle courses and study programme in technology. To meet the specific entry requirements, you must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.  

You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.

You should have a Master’s degree or equivalent in, for example, biosystems/agricultural engineering, environmental engineering, agricultural science, energy systems, industrial ecology, environmental science or a related field.

Your profile

We are looking for a motivated candidate interested in sustainable agricultural and bioeconomy systems and quantitative analysis.

Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is desirable:

    systems analysis, modelling or scenario analysis;
    GIS and spatial analysis;
    life cycle assessment, environmental systems analysis or material-flow analysis;
    techno-economic or socio-economic assessment;
    bioenergy, biogas or biorefinery systems;
    agricultural production systems and agricultural biomass;
    statistical analysis and handling of larger datasets;
    experience of programming or quantitative modelling, for example using Python, R or MATLAB.

You should have good analytical skills, be able to integrate information from different fields, work independently and collaborate well.

Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not required.

Personal qualities, motivation and the ability to successfully complete doctoral studies will be given considerable weight.

About us

The Department of Biosystems and Technology develops knowledge for sustainable and resource-efficient agriculture, horticulture and bioeconomy through research combining biological production systems, technology and systems analysis.

The project lies at the intersection of agriculture, biosystems engineering, sustainability assessment and bioeconomy.

Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/

Form of employment / Funding

Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme)

Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.

Location:

Alnarp, Sweden

Scope:

100%

Start date:

Upon agreement. A start date in January or February 2027 is preferred.



Application and selection:



Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is November 27, 2026.

Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/

Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.

title: Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden
description:
Dignus Medical specializes in recruiting doctors, specialists and nurses for the healthcare sector across Scandinavia. We help solve staffing challenges by matching the right professionals with the right employers – at the right time.

Family medicine specialist career opportunities across Sweden

Sweden has a growing demand for specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine within primary healthcare. Through Dignus Medical, a Scandinavian medical recruitment company with more than 20 years of experience, physicians from across Europe can explore long-term career opportunities within Swedish primary care.

We collaborate with modern primary care centres across Sweden, from smaller community clinics to larger multidisciplinary healthcare centres. Our role is to help you find a position that matches your professional interests, preferred location and work-life balance.

Primary care physicians in Sweden play a central role in the healthcare system and work with a broad variety of cases, long-term patient relationships and close collaboration with other healthcare professionals.

Professional Development

General practitioners in Sweden work in a clinically focused environment with opportunities to develop areas of special interest. Many clinics also offer opportunities to participate in teaching or supervision of junior doctors, particularly in larger healthcare centres.

Relocation and Support

Relocating to another country is a major step. Dignus Medical supports you throughout the entire process from the first conversation to being fully established in Sweden.

Your personal advisor will assist with:

    medical licensing
    relocation planning
    practical matters related to moving and settling in

Our services are completely free of charge for physicians.

Support for Your Family

Many physicians relocate with their families. We therefore provide guidance regarding schools, childcare, housing and everyday life in Sweden.

We can also offer support for partners seeking employment, including opportunities within healthcare where relevant.

Language Training

To work independently as a physician in Sweden, Swedish language proficiency at C1 level is required.

Dignus Medical provides intensive online Swedish language training with experienced instructors. The training is flexible and adapted to your schedule.

Language courses can also be offered to accompanying partners and older children to support their integration.

Living in Sweden

Sweden offers a high quality of life, safe communities and excellent public services.

Physicians often appreciate the balance between professional responsibility and personal life, with structured working hours and good opportunities for outdoor activities, sports and family life.

Families benefit from high-quality childcare, subsidized preschool and free school meals for children.

Requirements

We are looking for physicians who:

    Hold an EU-recognised specialist certification in General Practice / Family Medicine
    Have good communication skills in English
    Are motivated to learn Swedish and relocate to Sweden

Interested in learning more?

We’d love to hear from you. Submit your application or contact us today to explore current openings.

Let us help you take the next step in your career as a general practitioner specialist in Sweden!

Send your CV and specialist certificate, and we will discuss suitable opportunities within our network of hospitals across Sweden. Dignus Medical will help match your profile with the right position and guide you throughout the entire process.

We look forward to receiving your application!

You can also register your CV (https://dignusmedical-en.recman.page/login) or sign up for our newsletter (https://www.dignusmedical.no/en/sign-up-for-newsletter/) to stay updated on future opportunities.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About the role

As a DevOps Engineer, you’ll own how our teams build, ship and run software. You’ll shape the platform, pipelines and infrastructure that let teams deliver quickly and safely, and you’ll make sure our services stay reliable, observable and secure in production. You’ll work in an autonomous setup where you’re trusted to set direction, not just keep the lights on.

What you’ll do

    Design, build and maintain CI/CD pipelines that let teams release frequently and with confidence.
    Manage cloud infrastructure as code, keeping environments consistent, reproducible and easy to change.
    Run and improve our container and orchestration platform, including scaling, upgrades and cost efficiency.
    Build observability into everything we run, from logging and metrics to tracing and alerting, so problems are found before customers notice them.
    Take part in incident response, lead blameless post-mortems, and turn the learnings into lasting improvements.
    Embed security into the delivery chain, including secrets management, access control, dependency scanning and compliance requirements.
    Investigate tooling and platform alternatives, make decisions, and document and justify them on your own initiative.
    Support and enable development teams so they can own their services in production.

What we’re looking for

    Recent, hands-on experience running production workloads on a major cloud platform such as Azure or AWS.
    Solid experience with infrastructure as code (e.g. Terraform, Bicep or similar).
    Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps or similar).
    Practical experience with containers and orchestration, preferably Kubernetes.
    Experience setting up monitoring, alerting and observability tooling.
    A security-minded approach to infrastructure and delivery.
    A track record of improving how teams work by automating, simplifying and removing friction.
    Evidence that you learn new technology on your own and apply it in real work.
    Comfort taking ownership in an autonomous team and setting technical direction.

About Simployer

At Simployer – We simplify being a great employer!

With 3,200 customers and 1.2 million users across our product lines, Simployer is the largest HRM cloud provider in Scandinavia. We are 300 employees across five cities in three countries.

Simployer helps organisations develop and take care of their employees, and offers digital HRM services that streamline internal routines and processes. Our product portfolio has solutions for every part of the employee journey.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note about an infrastructure or delivery improvement you drove and what difference it made. We review applications continuously.

title: OT SECURITY LEAD TO OX2
description:
How do you secure renewable energy assets where industrial control systems, cloud platforms and cybersecurity come together? At OX2, protecting wind, solar and energy storage facilities mean understanding both the technology behind energy production and the risks that come with connected systems. We are now looking for a OT Security Lead to take ownership of our cybersecurity priorities with operational technology at the center and help shape how security is managed across our growing energy portfolio.

YOU WILL

OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As the company expands its role as an independent power producer, cybersecurity is an important part of ensuring that its energy assets and the systems supporting them remain secure and reliable.  As OT Security Lead, you will take overall responsibility for cybersecurity across OX2's IT and operational technology environments, with a clear focus on OT. You will work across industrial control systems, cloud platforms and corporate IT, setting security requirements and ensuring that risks are understood and addressed throughout the development and operation of energy assets.

You will make risk-based decisions about which security measures are needed, where they should be implemented and how they should be prioritized across different facilities. Working closely with plant engineers, IT teams, suppliers and senior stakeholders, you will translate security requirements into practical solutions that work in operational environments.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

    

Own and prioritize the CSMS pipeline across OX2's wind, solar and energy storage assets.

    

Define security architecture and requirements across OT and IT, including SCADA, plant control systems, remote sites, Azure, AWS and SaaS environments.

    

Apply IEC 62443 and security principles such as zones and conduits, secure remote access, least privilege and security by design.

    

Establish and enforce cybersecurity requirements for suppliers, technology partners and external service providers.

    

Assess cybersecurity risks in vendor selection, acquisitions and divestments, contributing to cyber due diligence.

    

Govern external security partners and managed security service providers, including incident response and security delivery.

    

Translate NIS2 and relevant cybersecurity legislation into practical security measures across the business

    

The role involves collaboration across OX2's international business.

YOU ARE

You have a strong background in cybersecurity. You understand the challenges of protecting systems where security, availability and operational requirements need to work together. You have worked with OT and industrial control systems, including areas such as SCADA, plant networks and remote access. You have practical experience with IEC 62443 and understand how to apply security principles such as network segmentation, zones and conduits, least privilege and security by design. You also understand the connections between OT, corporate IT and cloud environments.

Your experience extends beyond individual projects. You have taken responsibility for security across multiple sites or technical environments, setting priorities, assessing risks and ensuring that security measures are implemented. You are used to working with external suppliers and know how to establish requirements and challenge solutions. Experience with MSSP governance, incident response or cyber due diligence is particularly valuable.

You are naturally curious and enjoy exploring new technologies and approaches to security. You make well-founded decisions. You can discuss technical details with engineers while explaining risks and priorities clearly to management. Most importantly, you follow through and make sure security requirements lead to real improvements. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from energy, utilities, industrial automation or other critical infrastructure environments is particularly valuable, but not essential if you bring strong practical OT security experience.

At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence how cybersecurity is managed across an international portfolio of renewable energy assets. You will work close to the technology behind energy production, with the responsibility and autonomy to develop security capabilities that protect both current operations and future assets.

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.

We are looking forward hearing from you!

ABOUT OX2

OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage.  With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden.  OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.

title: Associate professor in Environmental and Energy Systems Analysis
description:
Join Chalmers and help shape the future of sustainable maritime transport through internationally leading research with real-world impact. This position offers the opportunity to build and lead your own research agenda in a dynamic, collaborative environment at the forefront of the energy and environmental transition.

Chalmers University of Technology strives for academic excellence while also addressing the challenges and needs of society and industry. We offer a creative and dynamic environment for research, education, innovation and applied science. We aim to become a globally leading university of technology, with a strong emphasis on high-quality research and education, openness and collaboration.

At the recently formed https://www.chalmers.se/en/departments/env/ we identify, analyse and describe the major environmental challenges of our time, with the aim of developing models, tools and competitive technological solutions to support the transition in sectors such as energy, transport and heavy industry. A significant part of our research takes a systems perspective, focusing on the interaction between technology, society and the environment in order to develop resilient solutions for the future.

As part of the formation of our new department, we invite applications for a position as associate professor, focusing on environmental and energy systems analysis, in the area of maritime transport.

About the role

The associate professor is expected to lead, advance, and develop research in the area of maritime transport. Particular emphasis will be placed on research assessing the environmental impacts of shipping. Teaching responsibilities include close collaboration with Chalmers school of Maritime studies, and development of courses, primarily at master's and doctoral level, connected to the research area. Utilization of research results is an important part of the role, and the associate professor is expected to interact with both public and private stakeholders.

The appointment as Associate Professor is a permanent faculty position.

About the division and department

The Department of Environmental and Energy Sciences consists of five research divisions, with the common goal of providing excellent research that can enable solutions for transition to a sustainable society. The department offers a dynamic and inspiring academic environment, and well-developed networks with industry and relevant public stakeholders at national, international and global levels. The Maritime Environmental Science Division, with about 20 employees, strives to be a key player that provides science for the development of a sustainable transport sector with focus on maritime transport. We contribute by producing new knowledge through a combination of modelling and experimental work, and the development of new technology and decision support.

Your responsibilities

The position includes conducting and advancing research, education, and collaboration in close cooperation with colleagues across the department and university. In this role, you will be expected to:

    Conduct and lead research as an independent Principal Investigator at a high international standard.
    Contribute to teaching at all levels in collaboration with other faculty members.
    Continuously develop your pedagogical skills and actively contribute to the development of courses and educational programmes.
    Foster a vibrant academic culture and participate in departmental and university-wide activities.
    Supervise undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral students.
    Apply for external research funding to further strengthen and advance your research programme.
    Contribute to the development of your discipline both nationally and internationally.
    Actively support the dissemination and utilization of research results and contribute to academic citizenship.

Qualifications and merits

To qualify for the Associate Professor position, you have a doctoral degree in a relevant field and demonstrate independent scientific research of a high international quality and growing production of research.

You have:

    Performed research that has resulted in publications and presentations in relevant and respected venues for your field
    Demonstrated ability to acquire research funding
    Demonstrated ability to establish national and international collaborations.
    Supervised doctoral students as main and/or assistant supervisor
    Higher Education pedagogical training in accordance with the current SUHF recommendation (preferable)
    Teaching experience, including course development
    Well established national and international networks within the subject area
    Documented utilization of your research results in relevant societal fora
    Contributed to a good working environment in your current and former workplaces
    Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, in English

title: CLOUD & INFRASTRUCTURE LEAD TO OX2
description:
What does it take to keep a growing renewable energy business connected, secure and ready for the future? At OX2, cloud infrastructure supports everything from daily operations and business-critical systems to data platforms and AI. We are now looking for a Cloud & Infrastructure Lead to take ownership of our infrastructure landscape, shape its technical direction and ensure that our platforms support the business as it continues to develop.

YOU WILL

OX2 is a renewable energy company developing, constructing, owning and operating large-scale wind, solar and energy storage projects. As OX2 expands its role as an independent power producer, the demand for its digital infrastructure continues to grow. Secure, reliable and well-managed cloud platforms are essential to supporting operations across different markets, as well as the company's ambitions within data and AI.

As Cloud & Infrastructure Lead, you will take overall responsibility for OX2's cloud and infrastructure environment, spanning Azure, AWS and the services connecting them. You will set technical expectations, evaluate proposed solutions and follow up on delivery. You will also work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure that infrastructure decisions support both operational needs and future digital initiatives.

Your main responsibilities will be to:

    

Own and develop OX2's cloud infrastructure, including Azure and AWS architecture, landing zones, standards and governance.

    

Set technical direction across enterprise networking, connectivity and core infrastructure services.

    

Oversee identity and endpoint management, Windows and Linux environments, backup and recovery.

    

Strengthen cloud security and operational resilience, including disaster recovery, patching and vulnerability remediation.

    

Drive FinOps and cloud cost optimization, improving transparency around consumption, budgets and infrastructure investments.

    

Manage infrastructure suppliers and managed service providers, ensuring clear responsibilities, measurable service levels and reliable delivery.

The role has a broad international scope, with close collaboration across OX2's technology organization, business stakeholders and external partners

YOU ARE

You have a solid background in cloud and infrastructure and experience taking responsibility for complex technical environments. You understand how architecture, networking, security and operations fit together. You bring strong experience from Azure or AWS, or both, and a good understanding of enterprise networking and infrastructure architecture. You are familiar with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform, and have experience with several of the services surrounding cloud infrastructure, such as Entra ID, Intune, Defender, Windows or Linux environments, and backup and recovery.

You have worked closely with external suppliers or managed service providers and know how to set requirements, evaluate technical solutions and follow up on delivery. You also understand the financial side of infrastructure and have experience improving operational efficiency and managing cloud costs. You are comfortable making decisions and challenging established ways of working when needed. With a practical approach, you can move between detailed technical discussions and conversations with senior management, explaining not only what needs to be done but also why it matters to the business. You have a relevant educational background and are fluent in English. Experience from the energy sector, critical infrastructure or another regulated environment is valuable, but not required.

At OX2, you will have the opportunity to influence the infrastructure supporting an international renewable energy business. With broad responsibility and considerable autonomy, you will help shape the technical foundation for OX2's operations and continued development within data, AI and digital services

WANT TO KNOW MORE?

For questions about the role, please contact recruitment consultant Johanna Värmfors at johanna.varmfors@nexergroup.com or +46 730 821 230, or Artan Bitiqi at artan.bitiqi@nexergroup.com or +46 723 61 28 44.

We are looking forward hearing from you!

ABOUT OX2

OX2 is a renewable energy company accelerating the transition to a sustainable energy system. Through its integrated model as an independent power producer (IPP), OX2 develops, constructs, owns and manages renewable energy assets across onshore and offshore wind, solar and energy storage.

With a diversified portfolio of approximately 33 GW across development, construction, asset management and operations, OX2 combines entrepreneurial project development with long-term ownership and value creation. The company operates in five European markets and Australia, has approximately 500 employees, and is headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. OX2 is owned by EQT, one of the world's largest private equity investors.

title: R&D Engineer
description:
R&D Engineer (Battery Characterization)

Are you someone who speaks "Electrochemistry" as a second language? Do you find the perfect charge-discharge curve more satisfying than a morning coffee? If you are a lab-savvy engineer who bridges the gap between deep science and industrial reality, we want to talk to you.

The Role:

We are looking for an R&D Engineer to join our team and take the lead on in-depth and functional battery characterizations. This isn't just about running tests; it's about understanding the "consensus" behind the data. You will be the bridge between our synthesis lab and our final performance targets, providing critical feedback to optimize materials and refine our processes.

Required Expertise:

o  Proven laboratory experience with a focus on battery technologies. A degree with focus in electrochemistry and battery related materials synthesis is a merit.



o  A strong grasp of electrochemical characterization techniques and fundamentals.



o  Excellent communication skills, and can explain your results to colleagues and stakeholders with equal clarity.



o  A collaborative spirit; you enjoy giving (and receiving) constructive feedback to improve material performance.



o  You have walked in both worlds: prior experience in both academic research and industrial environments.



o  You are a natural organizer with experience in project coordination.



o  You have a track record of presenting at conferences or to external partners.

About Granode Materials:

Granode develops a disruptive technology in development of the silicon graphite composites, using widely available/cheap metallurgical micro-silicon without the use of hazardous gases such as silane etc. Granode’s anode composite promotes a drop-in solution compatible with conventional battery making technology with verified electrochemical performance over the battery life-cycle. As usage of the lithium-ion batteries (LiBs) multiplies, the specific requirements for higher energy density of the operating devices such as electric vehicles and the unmanned aviation is becoming more pronounced. Whilst the market for LiBs is experiencing drastic growth (27% per annum), the issues regarding sufficient energy density, availability of the raw materials and high costs are indeed critical drags for wide implementation and sustainable growth of such industry mainly in Europe. The unique anode technology developed at Granode offers significant improvement in the capacity and energy density of the LiBs compared to conventional graphite. In addition, it provides a sustainable and cheap platform for domestic supply chain of anodes.  

How to apply:

Please email your (1) CVs with title ’’ R&D Engineer’’ to address info@granode.com . There is no need for cover letter, (2) just write paragraph about your battery research/background and some of your problem-solving skills at previous relevant experiences.

title: Senior C++ Systems Developer - Live Media
description:
OFFER

When live video travels across networks, every part of the system needs to deliver. At Net Insight, you will work on the software that makes reliable media transport possible — solving demanding engineering problems together with experienced colleagues who enjoy sharing their knowledge.

We are looking for a senior C++ developer to join the Nimbra Edge team. This is a hands-on role with substantial technical ownership, where you will improve performance, investigate complex problems and influence the architecture behind a product used in professional media delivery.

Some of the reasons to join Net Insight:

    

Technically challenging work in modern C++23, close to Linux, networking and hardware.

    

The opportunity to influence architecture, implementation and development practices.

    

A small, autonomous team within an established international technology company.

    

Friendly, knowledgeable colleagues who value collaboration and open discussion.

    

Flexible working hours and a workplace that understands life outside work.



THE PRODUCT AND TEAM

Nimbra Edge enables the transport of live video across internet and private networks. You will join the team responsible for its dataplane: the C++ software that handles the actual flow of media through the system.

The dataplane team consists of four engineers and works closely with seven colleagues developing the cloud parts of the product. Together, they cover a broad technical scope, from cloud software to the systems interacting with the underlying hardware.

It is a friendly, collaborative group where you can discuss a difficult problem, challenge an idea and ask for another perspective. You will have room to work independently, with colleagues who support one another and care about the quality of the result.



THE ROLE

A central part of your work will be getting more from the available hardware: increasing channel capacity, reducing resource consumption and maintaining predictable performance under demanding conditions.

You will move between architectural decisions and detailed investigation, following a problem through the stack to understand its root cause. That might mean examining memory access and concurrency, analysing network traffic or investigating how Linux scheduling affects latency.

Your work will include:

    

Developing and improving performance-critical software in modern C++.

    

Profiling and optimising CPU, memory and network resource usage.

    

Investigating difficult bugs across software, operating system and hardware interactions.

    

Making architectural decisions and building solutions that remain clear and maintainable.

    

Reviewing code and sharing technical knowledge within the team.

    

Testing and validating behaviour on real hardware in the lab.

The current focus includes high-performance packet processing with DPDK and uncompressed video and audio transport using SMPTE ST 2110. You will also encounter precision timing, Linux tuning and hardware-accelerated media processing.

You can learn ST 2110 and DPDK here. What you bring is the systems knowledge and engineering judgement needed to understand challenging problems and work through them.

YOUR PROFILE

You are an experienced developer who still enjoys being deeply involved in the code. You take initiative when the next step is unclear, investigate before drawing conclusions and look for solutions that keep the system as simple as possible.

You also enjoy working with others. You explain your reasoning, listen to different perspectives and share what you learn. Your technical contribution includes helping the team reach sound decisions together.

We are looking for:

    

10+ years of professional software development experience.

    

Deep knowledge of modern C++ and systems programming, including memory management, concurrency and performance profiling.

    

Strong Linux experience, including troubleshooting involving the operating system, scheduling or hardware.

    

Solid networking fundamentals and confidence analysing traffic and protocol behaviour at packet level.

    

Experience developing performance-critical or real-time software with demanding latency, jitter or throughput requirements.

    

The ability to take ownership of technical problems and make well-founded design decisions.

Experience with video streaming protocols and media transport is particularly valuable. Other relevant experience includes DPDK or XDP, precision time synchronisation, NICs and drivers, or hardware-accelerated media processing.

Your background may be in media technology, telecom, networking or another field with demanding systems and performance requirements. Previous broadcast experience is welcome, but is not required.

The team also uses AI tools in its development workflow, and welcomes curiosity about how they can support your work.

LOCATION Net Insight develops technology for professional media networks, helping broadcasters, service providers and media organisations transport live content reliably. Its engineering work spans hardware, networking and cloud software, bringing together specialists across several technical disciplines.

For more info, visit https://netinsight.net/

This recruitment is direct employment at Net Insight AB and all applications, questions, administration, and recruitment processes are managed by Pinetree AB.

title: Site Manager till FirstOffice Stockholm
description:
Om företaget

FirstOffice, en affärsenhet inom det börsnoterade fastighetsbolaget Corem, erbjuder flexibla kontorslösningar med arbetsplatser, mötesrum och service i professionella och inspirerande miljöer. Läs mer om FirstOffice här: FirstOffice

Om rollen

Som Site Manager ansvarar du för flera av FirstOffice enheter i Stockholm. Rollen är bred, självständig och affärsnära, där du är naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten och har regelbunden kontakt med kunder och medlemmar. Du arbetar med allt från visningar, uthyrning och inflyttningar till att lösa praktiska frågor och säkerställa att service och drift håller en hög nivå.

Teamet du ingår i utgår från Kista och där finns även FirstOffice tjänstebilar. Du kommer att ha fasta dagar då du jobbar från kontoret i Kista och övriga dagar utgår du från de FirstOffice-enheter du ansvarar för.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

I rollen ansvarar du för att skapa en välfungerande vardag för våra kunder och samtidigt driva affären framåt. Du arbetar både operativt och relationsskapande, med tydligt fokus på service, uthyrning och resultat.

Du kommer bland annat att:

    

Driva och utveckla dina enheter mot uppsatta mål inom uthyrning, kundnöjdhet och resultat

    

Bearbeta leads, genomföra visningar och driva uthyrningsprocessen från första kontakt till tecknat avtal

    

Bygga och utveckla långsiktiga relationer med både befintliga och potentiella kunder

    

Säkerställa en hög servicenivå och en välfungerande daglig drift på enheterna

    

Arbeta aktivt med nätverkande, kundaktiviteter och lokal marknadsbearbetning

    

Ansvara för budget, resultatuppföljning samt planering och utveckling av dina enheter

    

Samarbeta nära med övriga Site Managers, Service Managers och andra funktioner inom FirstOffice och Corem

Vi söker

Vi söker dig som trivs i en bred och operativ roll där du är nära både verksamheten och kunderna. Du har ett naturligt affärsdriv, tycker om att bygga relationer och ser möjligheter i det dagliga kundmötet. Du är prestigelös och lösningsorienterad och trivs med att växla mellan kundkontakt, praktiska frågor och administration. För dig är hög service och en välfungerande drift grunden för nöjda kunder och goda resultat. Du kommunicerar tydligt och professionellt, är lyhörd för människor omkring dig och trivs i en miljö där det förväntas att du tar egna initiativ.

För att trivas i rollen ser vi gärna att du:

    

Har erfarenhet av försäljning, kundnära och affärsdriven roll

    

Är strukturerad och van vid att självständigt planera och prioritera ditt arbete

    

Har god administrativ förmåga och är bekväm med budget, uppföljning och digitala verktyg

    

Är kommunikativ, lyhörd och tydlig i samarbetet med såväl kunder som kollegor

    

Är prestigelös och trivs med att växla mellan operativa, praktiska och mer affärsstrategiska arbetsuppgifter

    

Har eftergymnasial utbildning eller motsvarande relevant arbetslivserfarenhet

    

Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska och har goda kunskaper i engelska, både i tal och skrift

    

Har B-körkort

Tidigare erfarenhet från kontorshotell, coworking, fastighet, uthyrning eller liknande serviceverksamhet är meriterande, men inget krav. Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid din personlighet och din förmåga att skapa förtroende och få saker att hända.

Om Carotte

Carotte Staff är Carotte Groups specialistbolag för bemanning och rekrytering inom service och värdskap. Med 40 års erfarenhet av servicebranschen i ryggen levererar vi självgående och engagerad personal till hotell, konferens, kontorsservice, restaurang och fastighetsmiljöer. Genom Carotte Academy utbildar vi kontinuerligt våra konsulter inom service och värdskap. Vi finns med kontor i Stockholm och Göteborg och verkar över hela Sverige.

Ansökan

Detta är ett hyrrekrytering via Carotte Staff, vilket innebär att du inledningsvis är anställd av oss och därefter går över i tillsvidareanställning hos FirstOffice. Anställningsform: tillsvidareanställning med inledande provanställning Arbetstider: kontorstider Startdatum: Omgående

Urval sker löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan. Har du frågor om rollen är du välkommen att kontakta ansvarig rekryterare på Carotte Staff.

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan.

Business Intelligence Manager à 100 %
======================================

**L’Hôpital de La Tour** est un établissement de soins aigus de haut niveau, privé, indépendant et à dimension humaine. Ancré dans sa mission de restaurer la meilleure qualité de vie possible pour ses patients, l’Hôpital de La Tour place l’amélioration continue, l’excellence médicale et l’accompagnement de ses collaborateurs au cœur de ses priorités. L’institution emploie plus de 1’200 collaborateurs, représentant plus de 60 métiers, et collabore avec plus de 550 médecins agréés.  

Nous **recrutons un/e**

**Business Intelligence Manager à 100 % (ref : 2029\)**
--------------------------------------------------------

 

**Vous souhaitez conjuguer expertise BI, proximité avec les métiers et impact stratégique dans un environnement en pleine transformation ?**

Créée il y a six ans, la fonction Business Intelligence de l’Hôpital de La Tour accompagne aujourd’hui **plus de 100 utilisateurs au moyen de plus de 100 tableaux de bord**, alimentés par une douzaine de systèmes sources.

La fonction entre dans une nouvelle phase de son développement : migration de la plateforme de données, renforcement des données externes, analyses prédictives et création d’un portail destiné aux médecins.

Rattaché·e au CFO, vous êtes **l’interlocuteur ou l’interlocutrice privilégié·e de l’institution sur les sujets BI**. Vous assurez la continuité de l’unité tout en structurant son évolution et en renforçant la place de la data dans les processus décisionnels.

 

Votre rôle
-----------

À l’interface entre stratégie, technologie et métiers, vous pilotez une activité BI à fort impact et transformez les données en leviers concrets d’aide à la décision.

### Pilotage et développement de la BI

* Recueillir les besoins des métiers et développer de nouveaux tableaux de bord Power BI en lien avec la stratégie de l’Hôpital.
* Faire évoluer les sources de données avec la DSIO et contribuer à la migration de la plateforme.
* Contribuer au développement des analyses prédictives et du portail médecins.
* Renforcer la structure par le recrutement d’un adjoint et d’un stagiaire.


### Analyse et aide à la décision

* Réaliser des analyses ad hoc et stratégiques, notamment sur la facturation, les flux de patients et l’efficience de la dotation.
* Présenter les analyses aux directions et contribuer au pilotage de l’institution.
* Automatiser les traitements et les productions statistiques, notamment OFS et REKOLE.
* Intervenir sur des domaines variés : finance, facturation, ressources humaines, soins stationnaires et ambulatoires, pharmacie, codage médical, achats, qualité et médico\-technique.


### Gouvernance et qualité des données

* Gérer les droits d’accès et la sécurité des données : groupes, rôles et filtres par périmètre.
* Assurer la maintenance des tableaux de bord, les contrôles de qualité et les corrections nécessaires.
* Accompagner les utilisateurs dans l’interprétation des données et répondre aux demandes quotidiennes des services.
* Mettre en place un système de ticketing afin de structurer et prioriser les demandes.


Pourquoi rejoindre ce projet ?
------------------------------

* Prendre la responsabilité d’une fonction BI déjà solidement implantée dans l’institution.
* Piloter une nouvelle étape de transformation de la plateforme de données.
* Travailler au contact direct de la direction générale, du contrôle de gestion, de la DSIO et des responsables de services.
* Contribuer à des décisions ayant un impact concret sur les activités médicales, administratives et opérationnelles.
* Développer une équipe et structurer durablement l’activité BI.
* Rejoindre un établissement privé, indépendant et à dimension humaine.


 

Votre profil
------------

* Master ou bachelor universitaire ou HES en informatique, informatique de gestion, statistique, économie ou domaine équivalent.
* Minimum cinq ans d’expérience en business intelligence ou en analyse de données. Une expérience dans le secteur de la santé constitue un atout.
* Maîtrise de SQL et d’un outil de dashboarding tel que Power BI, Qlik, Looker ou Tableau.
* Maîtrise de R ou de Python et bonne maîtrise d’Excel.
* Capacité à comprendre les enjeux métiers et à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs non spécialistes.
* Rigueur, autonomie, sens des priorités et discrétion.
* Excellente maîtrise du français.


Envie de faire grandir la BI avec nous ?
----------------------------------------

Rejoignez l’Hôpital de La Tour et contribuez à transformer la donnée en décisions utiles, fiables et porteuses de valeur pour l’ensemble de l’institution.

**Pensum:** 80–100 %

**Anstellung:** Feste Stelle

**Start:** Nach Vereinbarung

**Arbeitsort:** Region Otelfingen

**Arbeitgeber:** Den Namen nennen wir Ihnen gerne im Gespräch

Kurz gesagt: Der Rahmen stimmt. Zudem lernen Sie nun den Arbeitsort besser kennen, denn genau darum geht es als Nächstes.
Otelfingen liegt in der Zürcher Unterland und bietet Sie mit seiner zentralen Lage zwischen Zürich und Baden beste Voraussetzungen für Ihren Arbeitsweg. Die ausgezeichnete Anbindung an die Bahn ermöglicht Ihnen eine schnelle und komfortable Pendlerfahrt. Die Region kombiniert ländlichen Charme mit guter Infrastruktur und Nähe zu urbanen Zentren, was sie zu einem attraktiven Arbeitsort für berufstätige Menschen macht.

### Diese Tätigkeiten erwarten Sie in Otelfingen

- Sie tragen dabei die Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess, von der Erhebung bis zur Auswertung

- Zudem: Durchführung ärztlicher Verordnungen sowie sichere Abgabe der Medikamente

- Zudem überwachen Sie die Vitalzeichen, denn Sie erkennen früh, wenn sich etwas ändert

- Darüber hinaus leiten Sie FaGe, Pflegeassistenz sowie Lernende fachlich an

- Ausserdem lückenlose Pflegedokumentation im elektronischen System

- Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzteschaft, Therapien sowie Angehörigen auf Augenhöhe

### Ihre Stärken für diese Stelle

- Zuerst das Fachliche: die Ausbildung als dipl. Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder FH

- Bei ausländischem Diplom: SRK-Anerkennung zwingend erforderlich

- Zudem Erfahrung in der Langzeitpflege, Akutpflege oder Reha

- Vor allem Verantwortung, Empathie sowie eine belastbare, ruhige Art

- Dazu sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mind. B2)

### Ihr Arbeitsumfeld: Akutspital

Sie arbeiten im Akutbereich eines Spitals: Patientinnen und Patienten kommen, genesen und gehen – der Rhythmus ist dynamisch. Dabei erleben Sie die ganze Bandbreite der Medizin, arbeiten interdisziplinär und entwickeln Ihre Fachkompetenz laufend weiter.

Kurz gesagt: Als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Otelfingen verbinden Sie Fachlichkeit mit einem Umfeld, das zu Ihnen passt. Darum lohnt sich diese Stelle doppelt.

### Der Beruf im Detail: Was macht eine diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH?

Als diplomierte Pflegefachperson HF/FH tragen Sie die fachliche Verantwortung über den ganzen Pflegeprozess. Sie erheben den Pflegebedarf, danach planen Sie die Massnahmen und werten die Ergebnisse aus. Zudem steuern Sie die Abgabe der Medikamente, überwachen Vitalzeichen und erkennen Veränderungen früh. Damit sichern Sie Tag für Tag die Qualität der Pflege.

Der Weg in diesen Beruf führt über die höhere Fachschule (HF) oder das Bachelorstudium Pflege (FH). Ausländische Diplome brauchen dafür eine [Anerkennung durch das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK)](https://www.redcross.ch/de/srk-anerkennung). Ausserdem stehen erfahrenen Fachpersonen viele Wege offen: ein Nachdiplomstudium (NDS), die Rolle als Berufsbildnerin oder die Teamleitung.
Der Arbeitsmarkt für diplomierte Pflegefachpersonen in Akutspitälern der Region Otelfingen zeigt eine anhaltend hohe Nachfrage, da Fachkräfte vielerorts knapp sind. Sie profitieren von ausgezeichneten Chancen auf dem Arbeitsmarkt und können zwischen attraktiven Positionen im 80-100%-Pensum wählen. iPersonal erleichtert Ihnen den Einstieg durch spezialisierte Vermittlung, umfassende Betreuung und direkten Zugang zu renommierten Spitalarbeitgebern in Ihrer Region, sodass Sie schnell die richtige Stelle finden.

### Ihre Vorteile mit MediPersonal in der Region Otelfingen

- Kostenlose Weiterbildungen über [Temptraining](https://temptraining.ch) – somit bekommt Ihre Karriere Rückenwind

- Eine feste Beraterin begleitet Sie persönlich, von der Bewerbung bis zum ersten Tag

- Dazu schnelle sowie ehrliche Antworten – meist innerhalb von 24 Stunden

- Faire Verträge nach GAV, denn Ihr Lohn soll klar und offen sein

- Zudem eine langfristige Perspektive, denn wir vermitteln Stellen, die wirklich zu Ihrem Leben passen

- Und vor allem: Diskretion garantiert – Ihre Bewerbung behandeln wir streng vertraulich

### Häufige Fragen zur Stelle als Pflegefachfrau HF/FH Akutspital in Otelfingen

**Welche Ausbildung brauche ich für diese Stelle?**
Dafür benötigen Sie ein Diplom als Pflegefachfrau/-mann HF oder aber einen Bachelor in Pflege FH. Ausländische Abschlüsse sind mit SRK-Anerkennung ebenso willkommen.

**Ist mein ausländisches Pflegediplom in der Schweiz gültig?**
Ja, sofern das Schweizerische Rote Kreuz (SRK) Ihr Diplom anerkannt hat. Ausserdem beraten wir Sie gerne kostenlos zur Anerkennung.

**Wie schnell erhalte ich eine Rückmeldung auf meine Bewerbung?**
In der Regel melden wir uns bereits innerhalb von 24 Stunden bei Ihnen, denn Ihre Zeit ist wertvoll. Zudem halten wir Sie danach laufend auf dem neusten Stand.

**Erfahre ich den Namen des Arbeitgebers?**
Ja, selbstverständlich – denn im persönlichen Gespräch nennen wir Ihnen die Institution gerne. Denn Offenheit gehört bei uns dazu.

Gut zu wissen: Viele weitere [offene Stellen](https://med-ipersonal.ch/offene-stellen/), Jobs und Stellenangebote in Pflege und Medizin finden Sie rund um die Uhr auf med-ipersonal.ch.
